stories.title: Reformation 把店里的地毯带回家
stories.titleEn: Reformation brings its store rugs home
stories.zhDeck: Reformation 门店里的地毯，过去是品牌空间的一部分，却不是顾客可以买回家的商品。
stories.enDeck: The rugs inside Reformation stores have been part of the brand’s spaces, but were not previously products customers could take home.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Reformation 门店里的地毯，过去是品牌空间的一部分，却不是顾客可以买回家的商品。11 月 9 日，品牌与法国地毯工作室 Les Éditions de Tapis 发布九款限量、按订单制作的地毯，把这段门店合作延伸到家居。官方商品页将它们放进同一个系列；Vogue 与 Architectural Digest 的采访则把合作追溯到双方为门店共同设计地毯的五年。 [系列页面](https://www.thereformation.com/ref-x-les-editions-de-tapis.html) · [Vogue](https://www.vogue.com/article/reformation-first-rug-collection-les-editions-de-tapis)

据 Cohan 在 Architectural Digest 的采访中所说，顾客在店里看到地毯后，曾询问能否购买。Reformation 创意总监 Lauren Caris Cohan 与工作室创办人 Thomas Coccimiglio 因此把原本服务于零售空间的设计，重新组织成家用系列。棕榈、天鹅、鸟与猫等手绘形象搭配边饰和留白，让地毯既是房间里的实用物件，也成为一幅铺在地上的图。 [Architectural Digest](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/story/reformation-debut-home-collection)

设计所说的巴黎与洛杉矶，也不是一项抽象的城市标签。Coccimiglio 在 Vogue 采访中把它解释为两种彼此想象的文化：法国人想象洛杉矶的电影、摇滚与魅力，美国人则想象法国历史与宫廷。Architectural Digest 记录了其中的具体图案选择——交错的棕榈、天鹅和粉蓝色——以及创作者如何回看多年门店设计。系列由此把品牌熟悉的店内视觉，转成可辨认但不完全重复的家居语言。 [Vogue](https://www.vogue.com/article/reformation-first-rug-collection-les-editions-de-tapis) · [Architectural Digest](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/story/reformation-debut-home-collection)

每款从手绘稿开始，再由印度和尼泊尔工匠手工打结；材料包括羊毛、亚麻与丝。品牌的 Swans Fans 5 × 7 英尺款标价 1,200 美元，商品页列出的预估交付周期为购买后约四至六周。它们是高价、限量、按单制作的物件，现有材料不足以说明这种做法的环境影响，也不能据此推断 Reformation 将持续扩展家居业务。Forbes Vetted 转述品牌称目前没有进一步进入家居品类的确定计划。 [系列页面](https://www.thereformation.com/ref-x-les-editions-de-tapis.html) · [Swans Fans 商品页](https://www.thereformation.com/products/swans-fans-rug---5-x-7/1321528ENC.html?dwvar_1321528ENC_color=ENC) · [Forbes Vetted](https://tollbit.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/2026/11/09/reformation-rugs-launch/)

地毯原先出现的空间，也能说明这段合作的来处。2023 年纽约 SoHo 门店在一栋 1881 年建筑里混合新旧元素，试衣间配备触屏；2026 年巴黎门店则把手结地毯放在陶土砖、木饰面与 Murano 玻璃之间。两家店的设计不同，却都把衣服放进一套完整的室内场景。[Retail Dive 的 SoHo 门店报道](https://www.retaildive.com/news/reformation-opens-soho-flagship-dtc/654124/) · [PalaceScope 的巴黎门店介绍](https://www.palacescope.com/les-nouvelles-boutiques-a-decouvrir/)

Coccimiglio 在一段较早的设计师访谈中说，他会从想象中的地点或故事开始画草图，也会考虑一件作品如何进入现有室内。这是他对一般工作方法的描述，并非这次系列每款图案的制作记录。[设计师访谈](https://lcdpgirls.com/blogs/stories-women/collaboration-with-thomas-coccimiglio)

所以，这次发布更适合被看作一次空间身份的商品化：顾客把门店记忆带回家，品牌则把服装之外的设计语言变成可购买的对象。值得留意的是，一件店内物经由顾客的询问，获得了新的使用场景；它能否成为长期产品线，仍需后续事实回答。
stories.enMarkdown:
The rugs inside Reformation stores have been part of the brand’s spaces, but were not previously products customers could take home. On November 9, the brand and French rug studio Les Éditions de Tapis released nine limited, made-to-order designs, extending their retail collaboration into the home. The official collection page presents them as one range; interviews in Vogue and Architectural Digest trace the partnership to five years of designing rugs for Reformation stores. [系列页面](https://www.thereformation.com/ref-x-les-editions-de-tapis.html) · [Vogue](https://www.vogue.com/article/reformation-first-rug-collection-les-editions-de-tapis)

According to Cohan’s interview with Architectural Digest, shoppers saw the rugs in stores and asked whether they could buy them. Reformation chief creative officer Lauren Caris Cohan and studio founder Thomas Coccimiglio then reshaped work originally made for retail spaces into a collection for homes. Hand-drawn palms, swans, birds, and a cat sit alongside borders and open areas, making each rug both a useful object and an image laid across the room. [Architectural Digest](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/story/reformation-debut-home-collection)

The Paris and Los Angeles references are more than abstract city labels. In Vogue, Coccimiglio describes two cultures imagining one another: French ideas of Los Angeles through cinema, rock ’n’ roll, and glamour, and American ideas of French history and court life. Architectural Digest records specific choices—crossed palms, swans, and pink and blue—and how the designers revisited years of store designs. The collection turns a familiar in-store visual language into something recognizable without simply repeating it. [Vogue](https://www.vogue.com/article/reformation-first-rug-collection-les-editions-de-tapis) · [Architectural Digest](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/story/reformation-debut-home-collection)

Each design begins as a drawing and is hand-knotted by artisans in India and Nepal, using materials that include wool, linen, and silk. The brand lists the 5 × 7-foot Swans Fans rug at $1,200 and estimates a lead time of four to six weeks from purchase. These are expensive, limited, made-to-order objects. The available evidence does not establish their environmental impact, nor does it show that Reformation will keep expanding into home goods. Forbes Vetted reports that the brand has no firm plans for further home-category expansion. [系列页面](https://www.thereformation.com/ref-x-les-editions-de-tapis.html) · [Swans Fans 商品页](https://www.thereformation.com/products/swans-fans-rug---5-x-7/1321528ENC.html?dwvar_1321528ENC_color=ENC) · [Forbes Vetted](https://tollbit.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/2026/11/09/reformation-rugs-launch/)

The spaces where the rugs first appeared help explain the collaboration. The 2023 SoHo flagship mixed contemporary and vintage elements inside an 1881 building, with touchscreens in its fitting rooms. A 2026 account of the Paris store describes hand-knotted rugs alongside terracotta tiles, woodwork and Murano glass. The two stores differ, but both put clothing inside a complete interior scene. [Retail Dive on SoHo](https://www.retaildive.com/news/reformation-opens-soho-flagship-dtc/654124/) · [PalaceScope on Paris](https://www.palacescope.com/les-nouvelles-boutiques-a-decouvrir/)

In an earlier interview, Coccimiglio described starting with an imagined place or story, sketching from it, and considering how an object might sit within an existing interior. It describes his general process, not the making of every design in this release. [Designer interview](https://lcdpgirls.com/blogs/stories-women/collaboration-with-thomas-coccimiglio)

The launch is best read as the commercialization of a spatial identity: customers can take a memory of the stores home, while the brand turns a design language beyond clothing into an object for sale. A store object gained a new setting through customers’ questions. Whether it becomes a lasting product line remains an open question.

stories.title: Stella McCartney 与奈良美智的第三次合作
stories.titleEn: Stella McCartney and Yoshitomo Nara collaborate for a third time
stories.zhDeck: Stella McCartney 与奈良美智的第三次合作，品牌英文页面预告 11 月 11 日在官网及部分精品店发售，具体地区与渠道仍需核对。
stories.enDeck: The English-language brand page lists November 11 for the release of Stella McCartney and Yoshitomo Nara’s third collaboration through its website and selected boutiques; availability still needs to be checked by region and channel. The brand calls it “Rock’n’Roll Forest” and describes the collection as bringing Nara’s characters into fashion while connecting art, fashion, and music. What can be confirmed now is a capsule of ready-to-wear, bags, shoes, and accessories. The brand’s phrase “wearable art” ultimately has to be judged through those specific objects. Stella McCartney
stories.zhMarkdown:
Stella McCartney 与奈良美智的第三次合作，品牌英文页面预告 11 月 11 日在官网及部分精品店发售，具体地区与渠道仍需核对。品牌把它命名为「Rock’n’Roll Forest」，并称这是把奈良的角色带入时装语境、连接艺术、时尚与音乐的一章。眼下可确认的内容，是成衣、手袋、鞋与配饰组成的胶囊系列；品牌语言所说的“可穿戴艺术”，最终要落到这些具体物件上看。 [Stella McCartney](https://www.stellamccartney.com/pr/en/yoshitomo-nara-stella-mccartney.html)

这次联名跨越了印花、手工针织与鞋履。ELLE 日本报道提到四件在品牌工坊制作的手工作品，其中一条手织围巾约需 40 小时；另有采用刺绣图案的针织衫。鞋款则加入 adidas，基于 Tokyo 64 田径鞋重新设计。此处需要保留品类差异：一条围巾的制作时间不能代表整组系列，鞋款也属于三方合作，而非仅由 Stella 与奈良共同完成。 [ELLE Japan](https://www.elle.com/jp/fashion/a74356265/stellamccartney-yoshitomonara-2611/) · [Artsy](https://www.artsy.net/article/artsy-editorial-stella-mccartney-yoshitomo-nara-unveil-limited-edition-collection)

品牌用「Rock’n’Roll Forest」将艺术家的角色、服装与音乐放在同一叙事里。比起把这套说法直接等同于艺术家的全部创作，值得关注的是图像怎样进入不同物件：从印花到刺绣、针织和鞋履，制作方式改变了它被穿着和观看的方式。这个判断来自系列呈现，而不是对艺术家意图的推测。

音乐也有一段更长的创作背景。洛杉矶郡艺术博物馆在回顾 1984 至 2020 年作品的展览指南中，以音乐作为理解奈良绘画和雕塑的一条线索；他为《My Drawing Room》选过一组歌曲。这解释了为什么音乐适合成为观看其作品的入口，不能替代艺术家对本次胶囊系列的具体说明。[LACMA 展览指南](https://www.lacma.org/guides/nara)

伊势丹新宿列出的活动时间为 11 月 11 日至 12 月 8 日，首日上午抽签决定入场资格，下午抽签决定入场顺序。具体单品与入场规则应以店方公告为准，也不能把新宿的时间自动套到其他地区。[伊势丹新宿公告](https://www.mistore.jp/store/shinjuku/shops/women/the_space/shopnews_list/shopnews062.html)

在日本，ELLE 还预告了伊势丹新宿和阪急梅田的限时空间，报道说会使用再利用展具、纸和纸板装置，并播放双方策划的歌单。这些活动呈现的是此次联名的线下体验，不足以证明全球各地会采用相同设置。品牌把衣服、手作、音乐和空间放进同一传播场景，强化了联名的可体验性；它是否让奈良的图像获得新的观看方式，还要等作品与实际陈列出现后再判断。 [ELLE Japan](https://www.elle.com/jp/fashion/a74356265/stellamccartney-yoshitomonara-2611/) · [伊势丹新宿](https://www.mistore.jp/store/shinjuku/shops/women/the_space/shopnews_list/shopnews062.html)
stories.enMarkdown:
The English-language brand page lists November 11 for the release of Stella McCartney and Yoshitomo Nara’s third collaboration through its website and selected boutiques; availability still needs to be checked by region and channel. The brand calls it “Rock’n’Roll Forest” and describes the collection as bringing Nara’s characters into fashion while connecting art, fashion, and music. What can be confirmed now is a capsule of ready-to-wear, bags, shoes, and accessories. The brand’s phrase “wearable art” ultimately has to be judged through those specific objects. [Stella McCartney](https://www.stellamccartney.com/pr/en/yoshitomo-nara-stella-mccartney.html)

The collaboration spans printed images, hand-knitted pieces, and footwear. ELLE Japan reports four hand-finished pieces made in the brand’s atelier, including a hand-knitted scarf that takes about 40 hours, as well as a knit with an embroidered motif. An adidas shoe reworks the Tokyo 64 track shoe. These categories need to stay distinct: one scarf’s production time does not describe the whole collection, and the shoe is a three-way collaboration rather than a project by Stella McCartney and Nara alone. [ELLE Japan](https://www.elle.com/jp/fashion/a74356265/stellamccartney-yoshitomonara-2611/) · [Artsy](https://www.artsy.net/article/artsy-editorial-stella-mccartney-yoshitomo-nara-unveil-limited-edition-collection)

The brand’s “Rock’n’Roll Forest” puts the artist’s characters, clothing, and music into one narrative. Rather than taking that campaign language as a complete account of Nara’s practice, it is useful to look at how the images move between objects: printing, embroidery, knitwear, and footwear each change how an image is worn and seen. That is a reading of the collection, not a claim about the artist’s intentions.

Music has a longer place in Nara’s practice. In its guide to an exhibition spanning work from 1984 to 2020, the Los Angeles County Museum of Art uses music as one way into his paintings and sculpture; the artist also selected songs to accompany *My Drawing Room*. That history offers context for looking at his work, without supplying his intentions for this capsule. [LACMA exhibition guide](https://www.lacma.org/guides/nara)

Isetan Shinjuku lists its event from November 11 through December 8, with a morning lottery determining admission and an afternoon lottery determining entry order on the first day. Product availability and entry rules belong to that store’s announcement; its dates should not be assumed for other regions. [Isetan Shinjuku](https://www.mistore.jp/store/shinjuku/shops/women/the_space/shopnews_list/shopnews062.html)

In Japan, ELLE also previews temporary spaces at Isetan Shinjuku and Hankyu Umeda. Its report says they will use reused fixtures and paper and cardboard installations, with a playlist curated by the two collaborators. This describes the Japanese events and does not establish that the same setup will appear elsewhere. Bringing clothes, handwork, music, and space into one campaign makes the collaboration more experiential. Whether it changes how Nara’s images are seen will be clearer once the objects and displays are in front of audiences. [ELLE Japan](https://www.elle.com/jp/fashion/a74356265/stellamccartney-yoshitomonara-2611/) · [伊势丹新宿](https://www.mistore.jp/store/shinjuku/shops/women/the_space/shopnews_list/shopnews062.html)

stories.title: 西岸艺术与设计博览会的滨江现场
stories.titleEn: West Bund opens: art across the scales of a city
stories.zhDeck: 2026 年西岸艺术与设计博览会于 11 月 10 日在上海启动，活动延续至 15 日；公众开放时间为 12 日至 15 日。
stories.enDeck: West Bund Art & Design began in Shanghai on November 10 and runs through November 15, with public admission from November 12–15.
stories.zhMarkdown:
2026 年西岸艺术与设计博览会于 11 月 10 日在上海启动，活动延续至 15 日；公众开放时间为 12 日至 15 日。四个场地、150 多家参展机构构成这一届的基本规模，但更值得看的不是数字本身，而是作品如何在美术馆、画廊展位和城市文化空间之间移动。[上海市政府介绍](https://english.shanghai.gov.cn/en-ArtExhibitions/20261104/fa372fd1c7ed4e9fa6c00f4c7cb41155.html)；[官方活动日程](https://westbundonline.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/EDM/2026-11-06/2026%20Westbund%20VIP%20Program.pdf)。

在画廊的安排中，这种差异已经显现。Hauser & Wirth 的展位把 Louise Bourgeois、张恩利等艺术家的作品与出版物放在同一场景；[亚洲艺术中心](https://asiaartcenter.org/en/art-fairs/55/overview/)则带来十位艺术家的作品。这些安排让人看到，画廊如何在有限空间中组织不同代际和媒介。[Hauser & Wirth 展位介绍](https://www.hauserwirth.com/zh-Hant/art-fairs/west-bund-2026/)。

材料也改变了观看的速度。[Lighthouse Kanata](https://lighthouse-kanata.com/en/exhibitions/west-bund-art-design-2026/) 展出冨樫葉子的玻璃作品；画廊的 [《Bloom Softly 2-26》](https://lighthouse-kanata.com/en/works/bloom-softly-2-26-by-yoko-togashi-2026/) 作品页记录了吹制、切割玻璃的材料和工艺。[Qualia Gallery](https://qualiagallery.com/art-fairs/11-west-bund-art-design-shanghai-2026/) 则将 Ru Xiaofan 和 Yulia Pinkusevich 的作品放入自己的展示脉络。走过展位时，可以把它们当作不同观看方式的提案，而不只是待辨认的名字。 冨樫在 [Homo Faber 的访谈](https://www.homofaber.com/en/artisans/yoko_togashi-glassblowing-tokyo)中说，她的工作结合玻璃受热流动的瞬间与冷却后雕琢、研磨的时间；这是她对自身工作方法的解释。

本届展位也出现了一次变动。米兰 Wizard Gallery 在 [11 月 7 日声明](https://www.wizardgallery.com/events/133-wizard-gallery-a-west-bund-art-design-art-fair-shanghai-booth-1c16/)中称，参展计划里的七件 Diango Hernández 作品无法展出，画廊因此决定退出。[Artribune 的采访](https://www.artribune.com/professioni-e-professionisti/fiere/2026/11/censura-diango-hernandez-fiera-shanghai-wizard-gallery/)记录了画廊主对撤展和成本的说明。画廊提出的原因尚未获得主管部门或博览会的独立回应，不能据此断定完整经过。

回看往届，博览会里的媒介和商业环境也在变化。2022 年，《解放日报》的[报道](https://www.shou.org.cn/_upload/article/files/6b/3c/f84352da42a49a34a4c72769c435/a549926d-23cb-41fc-bd68-68c63441f359.pdf)记录西岸“视角”单元的一场数字艺术展，涉及 15 位中国艺术家的 19 件作品。2024 年，法国《世界报》采访当时同时参加西岸的画廊主 Magda Danysz，记录了她对当时买家信心的担忧。这是[一位画廊主对当时市场的观察](https://www.lemonde.fr/en/culture/article/2024/12/09/in-china-luxury-and-fine-crafts-diplomacy_6735677_30.html)。它们提醒我们，艺术周既是文化现场，也在持续面对媒介和市场的变化。

西岸的意义也不能只由现场成交衡量。2019 年关于艺博会的[研究](https://researchonline.rca.ac.uk/4016/1/Art%20Fair%20Innovations%20-%20summary%20findings%20JC.pdf)曾讨论教育和公共参与在博览会中的位置。对于今年，更具体的问题是：博览会结束之后，这些短暂相遇能否继续变成看展、学习和与城市发生关系的习惯。
stories.enMarkdown:
West Bund Art & Design began in Shanghai on November 10 and runs through November 15, with public admission from November 12–15. Across four venues and more than 150 participating organisations, the fair offers a chance to see how art moves between gallery booths, cultural institutions and the wider city. [Shanghai city overview](https://english.shanghai.gov.cn/en-ArtExhibitions/20261104/fa372fd1c7ed4e9fa6c00f4c7cb41155.html); [official programme](https://westbundonline.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/EDM/2026-11-06/2026%20Westbund%20VIP%20Program.pdf).

The booths propose different ways of assembling a scene. [Hauser & Wirth](https://www.hauserwirth.com/zh-Hant/art-fairs/west-bund-2026/) brings together works by artists including Louise Bourgeois and Zhang Enli alongside publications; [Asia Art Center](https://asiaartcenter.org/en/art-fairs/55/overview/) presents ten artists. Neither is a complete picture of the field, but each shows how a gallery makes connections across generations and media within a limited space.

Material changes the pace of looking, too. [Lighthouse Kanata](https://lighthouse-kanata.com/en/exhibitions/west-bund-art-design-2026/) presents glass by Yoko Togashi; its page for [Bloom Softly 2-26](https://lighthouse-kanata.com/en/works/bloom-softly-2-26-by-yoko-togashi-2026/) identifies the medium as blown and cut glass. [Qualia Gallery](https://qualiagallery.com/art-fairs/11-west-bund-art-design-shanghai-2026/) places works by Ru Xiaofan and Yulia Pinkusevich in another context. In an [interview with Homo Faber](https://www.homofaber.com/en/artisans/yoko_togashi-glassblowing-tokyo), Togashi describes her practice as bringing together the moment glass moves under heat and the slower work of carving and polishing it after cooling. This is her account of her wider practice.

One planned booth has also changed. In a [November 7 statement](https://www.wizardgallery.com/events/133-wizard-gallery-a-west-bund-art-design-art-fair-shanghai-booth-1c16/), Milan’s Wizard Gallery said seven works by Diango Hernández could not be shown and that it had consequently withdrawn. [Artribune interviewed](https://www.artribune.com/professioni-e-professionisti/fiere/2026/11/censura-diango-hernandez-fiera-shanghai-wizard-gallery/) the gallery owner about the withdrawal and its costs. The gallery’s explanation has not been independently confirmed by the fair or the relevant authority, so the full circumstances remain unresolved.

Earlier editions show how both media and commercial conditions change. In 2022, [Jiefang Daily](https://www.shou.org.cn/_upload/article/files/6b/3c/f84352da42a49a34a4c72769c435/a549926d-23cb-41fc-bd68-68c63441f359.pdf) reported on a digital-art exhibition in West Bund’s Perspective section, involving 19 works by 15 Chinese artists. That was a specific past exhibition, not evidence that the same programme is running this year. In 2024, [Le Monde interviewed](https://www.lemonde.fr/en/culture/article/2024/12/09/in-china-luxury-and-fine-crafts-diplomacy_6735677_30.html) gallerist Magda Danysz, then participating in West Bund, about her concerns over buyer confidence. Her individual observation cannot establish this year’s sales. Together, the historical accounts suggest that art week is a cultural meeting point shaped by changing media and market conditions.

A fair's value cannot be reduced to sales. A [2019 study of art-fair innovation](https://researchonline.rca.ac.uk/4016/1/Art%20Fair%20Innovations%20-%20summary%20findings%20JC.pdf) discussed education and public participation, though it says nothing about this year's results. The question for West Bund is what remains after the fair: whether a brief encounter becomes a habit of looking, learning and engaging with the city.

stories.title: GTA VI 把游戏音乐带到迈阿密现场
stories.titleEn: GTA VI brings a festival to Miami
stories.zhDeck: Rockstar 宣布将于 11 月 21 日在迈阿密 Wynwood 举办 GTA VI: The Festival，阵容包括 Travis Scott、Cardi B 等。
stories.enDeck: Rockstar has announced GTA VI: The Festival for November 21 in Miami's Wynwood, with a lineup including Travis Scott and Cardi B.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Rockstar 宣布将于 11 月 21 日在迈阿密 Wynwood 举办 [GTA VI: The Festival](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/gtavi-thefestival)，阵容包括 Travis Scott、Cardi B 等。游戏计划于 11 月 19 日推出，音乐节安排在发售之后。[Axios 的迈阿密报道](https://www.axios.com/local/miami/2026/11/09/gta-vi-announces-one-day-music-festival-in-miami)记录了公布的演出安排。

音乐不是这次发布的装饰。Rockstar 的[音乐项目页面](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/music)同时介绍游戏音乐、合作专辑及 Justice 的配乐发行计划，让游戏、唱片与现场演出共同成为这次文化发布的一部分。活动将在发售后举行，现场效果仍有待观察。

游戏与流行音乐的关系也有更长的历史。[DJ Mag 的 2020 年回顾](https://djmag.com/longreads/grand-theft-autos-musical-legacy-continued-push-boundaries-2020-heres-how)梳理过系列如何通过电台和游戏内俱乐部组织音乐；[Dazed 对新作的采访](https://www.dazeddigital.com/life-culture/article/70859/1/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-rockstar-exclusive-deep-dive-game-unparalleled-world)则呈现创作者谈及迈阿密音乐与环境的灵感。

这条音乐线索在游戏电台里也有具体的本地参与。[CBS Miami 的报道](https://www.cbsnews.com/miami/news/grand-theft-auto-vi-game-release-radio-station-trina-trick-daddy/)指出，迈阿密说唱歌手 Trina 和 Trick Daddy 将主持游戏电台 Dirty South Classics，当地厂牌 Slip-N-Slide Records 创办人 Ted Lucas 参与策划。两人曾在 2020 年主持南佛罗里达的真实广播节目。游戏里的城市声音因此有了本地音乐人与厂牌的具体连接。

虚构城市 Vice City 和真实迈阿密之间的关系，也不止一场派对能说清。[Axios 此前采访的迈阿密居民](https://www.axios.com/local/miami/2026/09/17/grand-theft-auto-miami-vice-controversy-debate)对城市形象有不同看法；Wynwood 本身也已有 [III Points 等音乐活动](https://manawynwood.com/news/iii-points-returns-to-mana-wynwood-in-2026-with-expanded-layout-and-phase-1-lineup-reveal/)。这次音乐节值得关注的，是一个虚构世界如何借真实城市的音乐网络落地，以及城市里的不同人如何回应它。
stories.enMarkdown:
Rockstar has announced [GTA VI: The Festival](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/gtavi-thefestival) for November 21 in Miami's Wynwood, with a lineup including Travis Scott and Cardi B. The game is scheduled for November 19, making the festival a post-release event. [Axios Miami](https://www.axios.com/local/miami/2026/11/09/gta-vi-announces-one-day-music-festival-in-miami) documents the announced programme.

Music is not incidental to this launch. Rockstar's [music page](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/music) presents game music, a collaboration album and a planned Justice score release, placing the game, records and live performance in the same cultural campaign. The festival has not happened yet, so its reception and practical outcome remain unknown.

The series has a longer relationship with popular music. A [2020 DJ Mag retrospective](https://djmag.com/longreads/grand-theft-autos-musical-legacy-continued-push-boundaries-2020-heres-how) examines radio and in-game clubs in earlier GTA titles; a [Dazed interview about the new game](https://www.dazeddigital.com/life-culture/article/70859/1/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-rockstar-exclusive-deep-dive-game-unparalleled-world) records its creators discussing Miami's music and environment. The retrospective is historical context, not evidence of how the new game plays.

The game’s radio stations also bring in specific local collaborators. [CBS Miami](https://www.cbsnews.com/miami/news/grand-theft-auto-vi-game-release-radio-station-trina-trick-daddy/) reports that Miami rappers Trina and Trick Daddy host the in-game station Dirty South Classics, with local Slip-N-Slide Records founder Ted Lucas involved in its curation. The pair previously hosted a real South Florida radio show in 2020. Their participation gives the fictional city a concrete connection to Miami musicians and an independent label.

The relationship between fictional Vice City and real Miami cannot be resolved by one party. [Miami residents interviewed earlier by Axios](https://www.axios.com/local/miami/2026/09/17/grand-theft-auto-miami-vice-controversy-debate) expressed differing views on the city's portrayal, while Wynwood already hosts events such as [III Points](https://manawynwood.com/news/iii-points-returns-to-mana-wynwood-in-2026-with-expanded-layout-and-phase-1-lineup-reveal/). The interesting question is how a fictional world draws on a real music network—and how people in that city respond.

stories.title: Leon Xu：在城市日常与记忆之间作画
stories.titleEn: Leon Xu paints the city between memory and night
stories.zhDeck: Artsy 在 11 月 9 日发布的 Vanguard 2027 采访中，画家 Leon Xu 谈到纽约夜色、街角小店的花和城市灯光。
stories.enDeck: In an Artsy Vanguard 2027 interview published November 9, painter Leon Xu discusses New York at night, flowers outside bodegas and the city's light.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Artsy 在 11 月 9 日发布的 [Vanguard 2027 采访](https://www.artsy.net/article/artsy-editorial-artsy-vanguard-2027-leon-xu)中，画家 Leon Xu 谈到纽约夜色、街角小店的花和城市灯光。照片是他收集生活片段的方式之一，但画面最终不必忠实复刻镜头：它更接近一个人在城市里走过之后，仍留在脑中的气氛。

这种距离感早已有迹可循。在 2025 年的 [SSENSE 采访](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/editorial/culture/leon-xu-painter-interview)里，Xu 说他会把手机照片放在视线边缘，避免直接照搬；他也谈到展览《Afterglow》与马丁·斯科塞斯电影《下班后》的联系。[Mai 36 画廊的展览记录](https://mai36.com/exhibitions/leon-xu)提供了另一条进入作品的路径。照片既是线索，也是可以被偏离的起点。

早在 2020 年，[It's Nice That](https://www.itsnicethat.com/articles/leon-xu-art-251120) 记录过他对城市表面、涂鸦与记忆的兴趣；2023 年的 [Brooklyn Rail 展评](https://brooklynrail.org/2023/06/artseen/Leon-Xu-Empty-Orchestra/)则注意到《Empty Orchestra》中取景的方式。时间、车窗与霓虹让人似乎身处街上，却很难指出一个明确的故事正在发生。

这种对瞬间的留意也与他的生活节奏有关。Xu 在 [2022 年 BOOOOOOOM 采访](https://www.booooooom.com/2022/09/08/artist-spotlight-leon-xu/)中谈到持续工作对创作的消耗，以及寻找平静片刻的重要性。与 Xu 相识的摄影师 Jacob Consenstein 在[一篇工作室访谈](https://www.jacobconsenstein.com/artist-series)中写到，疫情期间，汽车曾成为 Xu 观察城市的空间。两段材料让“城市夜景”有了更具体的背景：看见什么，也取决于一个人何时有时间停下来。

看 Xu 的作品，吸引人的并非某座城市被准确描绘，而是熟悉的景色在颜色和模糊中变得有些陌生。[Impulse 的评论](https://www.impulsemagazine.com/articles/photographic-painting-in-new-york)将他的绘画放进纽约摄影性绘画的更大语境；[Mai 36 对 2022 年展览的记录](https://mai36.com/exhibitions/09-10-2022-leon-xu)也提示，这种对瞬间与记忆的处理有一段持续发展的历史。新的 Artsy 采访值得读，是因为它让我们再看一次：图像并不需要解释一切，才能让人想起自己的夜晚。
stories.enMarkdown:
In an [Artsy Vanguard 2027 interview published November 9](https://www.artsy.net/article/artsy-editorial-artsy-vanguard-2027-leon-xu), painter Leon Xu discusses New York at night, flowers outside bodegas and the city's light. Photographs help him collect fragments of life, but the resulting image need not reproduce the camera. It is closer to the atmosphere that remains after someone has walked through a place.

That distance has long been part of his practice. In a [2025 SSENSE interview](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/editorial/culture/leon-xu-painter-interview), Xu described keeping phone photographs at the edge of his vision to avoid copying them directly. He also connected his exhibition *Afterglow* to Martin Scorsese's *After Hours*. [Mai 36's exhibition record](https://mai36.com/exhibitions/leon-xu) offers another way into those works: the photograph is a clue, but also a point of departure.

[It's Nice That](https://www.itsnicethat.com/articles/leon-xu-art-251120) recorded his interest in urban surfaces, graffiti and memory in 2020; a [2023 Brooklyn Rail review](https://brooklynrail.org/2023/06/artseen/Leon-Xu-Empty-Orchestra/) considered the framing in *Empty Orchestra*. Time, car windows and neon suggest being on a street without explaining exactly what is happening there.

This attention to fleeting moments also relates to the pace of his life. In a [2022 BOOOOOOOM interview](https://www.booooooom.com/2022/09/08/artist-spotlight-leon-xu/), Xu discussed the strain of constant work and the importance of finding moments of calm. Photographer Jacob Consenstein, writing after a studio conversation, described how Xu used his car as a space from which to observe the city during the pandemic. [That earlier conversation](https://www.jacobconsenstein.com/artist-series) was between acquaintances, not an independent exhibition review. Both accounts give the city scenes a more specific context: what one sees also depends on when one has time to stop.

What holds the eye is not perfect documentation of a city, but a familiar scene made slightly unfamiliar through colour and blur. An [Impulse review](https://www.impulsemagazine.com/articles/photographic-painting-in-new-york) places Xu alongside other photographic painters in New York, while [Mai 36's record of his 2022 exhibition](https://mai36.com/exhibitions/09-10-2022-leon-xu) shows a longer development. The new Artsy interview is a reason to look again: an image does not have to explain everything to bring back a night of one's own.

stories.title: SICA 回到科托努：城市音乐进入竞赛
stories.titleEn: SICA returns to Cotonou
stories.zhDeck: 第 20 届 SICA 音乐节于 11 月 9 日至 15 日这一周在贝宁科托努举行。
stories.enDeck: The 20th SICA festival takes place in Cotonou, Benin, during the week of November 9–15.
stories.zhMarkdown:
第 20 届 SICA 音乐节于 11 月 9 日至 15 日这一周在贝宁科托努举行。主办方以文化传承与创新为主题，组织演出与奖项；关于开幕活动的具体日期，现有资料说法不一，出行前应以主办方最新日程为准。[节日官网](https://festivalsica.com/en/)；[活动报道](https://leleaderinfobenin.bj/festival-sica-cotonou-se-prepare-pour-une-semaine-de-celebration-culturelle/)。

[Matin Libre](https://matinlibre.com/2026/11/06/festival-sica-apres-cinq-editions-itinerantes-le-rendez-vous-revient-a-cotonou/)报道了活动回到科托努的安排。科托努也是这场音乐节的发源地。

来自不同国家的提名，让节日成为观察跨地区音乐网络的一个入口。[加蓬媒体](https://gabonmediatime.com/sica-2026-6-gabonais-a-la-conquete-de-prix-au-benin/)报道，入围者包括将传统节奏与 zouk、rumba 和 R&B 结合的 Candide Helga，以及参与城市音乐类别的说唱歌手 Marco IB；[几内亚媒体](https://guineenews.org/2026/09/08/musique-foudis-diallo-nominee-au-festival-sica-2026/?amp=1)介绍，入围的 Foudis Diallo 将牧歌、传统音色与蓝调相融合。这些是此前公布的提名，最终结果尚待揭晓。

往届获奖者的经历，也能让“传承与创新”落到具体的人身上。2023 年在喀麦隆举行的第 17 届 SICA 上，马里歌手 Kani Sidibé 获得大众奖。她随后向[《马里日报》](https://journaldumali.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/JDM-450.pdf)谈到，自己的音乐以 Wassoulou 为根，也借此纪念母亲；她同时提及录音和推广的成本。同一届的最佳音乐录像奖由刚果歌手 Maman Crédo 获得，见[刚果媒体报道](https://www.lesdepechesdebrazzaville.fr/_zbhfiles/download.php?doc=20231125_DBZ_DBZ_ALL_P.pdf)。在 [2025 年的另一篇采访](https://www.lecourrierdekinshasa.com/_zbhfiles/download.php?doc=20250118_DBZ_DBZ_ALL.pdf)中，她介绍自己发起的 Zaba 音乐节如何结合宗教民间音乐与城市节奏。

今年奖项引入城市音乐类别，不过城市音乐并非首次出现在节日舞台上：一份[2019 年报道](https://www.republicoftogo.com/content/download/76254/1912986/1)已记录组合 Toofan 的演出。类别变化值得关注，是因为它可能改变音乐如何被归档和评价；它是否真的扩大了音乐人的机会，还需要等活动结束后看更多证据。
stories.enMarkdown:
The 20th SICA festival takes place in Cotonou, Benin, during the week of November 9–15. Organisers frame performances and awards around cultural heritage and innovation. Available accounts differ on the exact opening-event date, so visitors should check the organiser's current programme. [Festival site](https://festivalsica.com/en/); [local report](https://leleaderinfobenin.bj/festival-sica-cotonou-se-prepare-pour-une-semaine-de-celebration-culturelle/).

[Matin Libre](https://matinlibre.com/2026/11/06/festival-sica-apres-cinq-editions-itinerantes-le-rendez-vous-revient-a-cotonou/) reports the return to Cotonou. Cotonou is also the festival's birthplace.

Nominations from different countries offer a view into a cross-regional music network. [Gabon Media Time](https://gabonmediatime.com/sica-2026-6-gabonais-a-la-conquete-de-prix-au-benin/) names nominees including Candide Helga, who combines traditional rhythms with zouk, rumba and R&B, and urban-music contender Marco IB. [Guinéenews](https://guineenews.org/2026/09/08/musique-foudis-diallo-nominee-au-festival-sica-2026/?amp=1) describes nominee Foudis Diallo's blend of pastoral and traditional sounds with blues. These were nominations announced ahead of the festival; the results are still to come.

Past winners make the idea of heritage and innovation more tangible. At the 17th SICA in Cameroon in 2023, Malian singer Kani Sidibé won the public prize. She told [Journal du Mali](https://journaldumali.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/JDM-450.pdf) that Wassoulou remained the foundation of her music and a way to honour her mother; she also spoke about the costs of recording and promotion. Congolese singer Maman Crédo won that edition’s best music-video award, according to [Congolese reporting](https://www.lesdepechesdebrazzaville.fr/_zbhfiles/download.php?doc=20231125_DBZ_DBZ_ALL_P.pdf). In a [separate 2025 interview](https://www.lecourrierdekinshasa.com/_zbhfiles/download.php?doc=20250118_DBZ_DBZ_ALL.pdf), she discussed the Zaba festival she founded and its combination of Christian-inspired folk music and urban rhythms.

The awards introduce an urban-music category this year, but urban music itself is not new to the festival: a [2019 report](https://www.republicoftogo.com/content/download/76254/1912986/1) records a performance by Toofan. The category matters because it may change how music is classified and judged. Whether it expands opportunities for musicians is a question for evidence after the festival.

stories.title: 釜山的旧工厂与废弃材料设计展
stories.titleEn: Design Busan enters an old factory
stories.zhDeck: 今年「设计釜山」将城市工业遗存纳入展览现场。
stories.enDeck: This year's Design Busan brings the city's industrial heritage into the exhibition itself.
stories.zhMarkdown:
今年「设计釜山」将城市工业遗存纳入展览现场。釜山市的[活动介绍](https://www.busan.go.kr/eng/ai-translated-press-releases/1761827)与[展览页面](https://design-busan.kr/en/exhibition)呈现了这场活动如何把设计、城市空间与公众体验放在一起。

[首尔经济日报的现场报道](https://en.sedaily.com/culture/2026/11/06/a-polar-bear-appears-in-a-rubber-factory-idle-for-40-years)写到，在一座闲置多年的橡胶工厂里，一只北极熊形象与由橡胶带构成的隔断共同出现在展场。材料带着工厂原有的生产痕迹，也让环境议题以可以直接感知的方式进入空间。

国立釜庆大学的[报道](https://www.pknu.ac.kr/main/51?action=view&no=726909)则记录了师生参与：教授使用回收橡胶带和网材处理外部空间，19 名学生以九组方案制作面板和模型。这些展览介入之后，现场如何长期维护仍是另一个问题。[本地评论](https://v.daum.net/v/QTT1VblwZu)也提出了后续管理的重要性。

材料的另一条线索通向海边和家庭。[首尔经济日报](https://en.sedaily.com/culture/2026/11/06/a-polar-bear-appears-in-a-rubber-factory-idle-for-40-years)介绍，Suan Art House 的展览中，Kim Pil-seop 的《Revival Project》使用废弃、破损或因纪念意义被保存的旧家具；Weekend Lab 则将面包店废蛋壳与海边收集的牡蛎壳转化为陶瓷材料。不同物件带来的不只是形状，还有各自被使用和丢弃的经历。

这里不是第一次打开工厂大门：2025 年的[本地报道](https://www.kookje.co.kr/news2011/asp/newsbody.asp?code=0500&key=20251020.22002004244)已记录相关空间的开放与历史。釜山获选 [2028 世界设计之都](https://wdo.org/busan-metropolitan-city-designated-world-design-capital-2028/)提供了更大的城市背景，但头衔无法替代对资源消耗、持续使用和社区关系的实际观察。设计真正的后续，发生在展览拆除之后。
stories.enMarkdown:
This year's Design Busan brings the city's industrial heritage into the exhibition itself. The [city's announcement](https://www.busan.go.kr/eng/ai-translated-press-releases/1761827) and [exhibition page](https://design-busan.kr/en/exhibition) frame the programme around design, urban space and public experience.

According to a [Seoul Economic Daily report](https://en.sedaily.com/culture/2026/11/06/a-polar-bear-appears-in-a-rubber-factory-idle-for-40-years), a polar-bear figure appears in a long-idle rubber factory alongside a partition made from rubber belts. The material retains a trace of the factory's production history and gives an environmental theme a physical presence.

[Pukyong National University](https://www.pknu.ac.kr/main/51?action=view&no=726909) describes another contribution: a professor used reclaimed rubber belts and netting outside, while 19 students worked in nine teams on panels and models. An exhibition intervention is not the same as permanent architectural renovation; long-term maintenance remains a separate question, as a [local commentary](https://v.daum.net/v/QTT1VblwZu) observes.

Another material story leads from the factory to the coast and the home. According to [Seoul Economic Daily](https://en.sedaily.com/culture/2026/11/06/a-polar-bear-appears-in-a-rubber-factory-idle-for-40-years), Kim Pil-seop’s *Revival Project* at Suan Art House uses damaged or discarded furniture, as well as pieces kept for their memories. Weekend Lab turns eggshells from bakeries and oyster shells collected by the shore into ceramic material. Each object brings not only a form but also a history of use and disposal.

The factory did not open to the public for the first time this year: [local reporting from 2025](https://www.kookje.co.kr/news2011/asp/newsbody.asp?code=0500&key=20251020.22002004244) already documented the space and its history. Busan's designation as [World Design Capital 2028](https://wdo.org/busan-metropolitan-city-designated-world-design-capital-2028/) gives the project a wider context, but a title cannot substitute for evidence about resources, continued use and community relationships. The test continues after the exhibition comes down.

stories.title: 京都银阁寺里的相客香：当代工艺与观看
stories.titleEn: Aikyakuko in Kyoto: craft, incense and space
stories.zhDeck: 11 月 8 日至 10 日，京都银阁寺举办的「相客香」以「闻香」的鉴赏方式为线索，把工艺作品放进寺院空间中。
stories.enDeck: From November 8–10, Aikyakuko brought craft works into the setting of Ginkakuji in Kyoto, taking the appreciation of incense as a conceptual point of reference.
stories.zhMarkdown:
11 月 8 日至 10 日，京都银阁寺举办的「相客香」以「闻香」的鉴赏方式为线索，把工艺作品放进寺院空间中。[主办方介绍](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000026.000061898.html)为这场短期展览提供了入口：器物、光线、建筑和人的行走共同组成了观看的条件。

陶艺家谷穹的实践提醒我们，泥土的最终形态来自一连串难以完全控制的变化。京都工艺纤维大学美术工艺资料馆在[早年展览资料](https://www.museum.kit.ac.jp/nap2014_qtani.html)中讨论过他对烧成温度与气氛的关注；[京都画廊的介绍](https://www.galleryrinkyoto.com/post/%E4%BF%A1%E6%A5%BD-%E9%99%B6%E8%8A%B8%E5%AE%B6-%E8%B0%B7%E7%A9%B9-taniq-%E4%BD%9C%E5%AE%B6%E7%B4%B9%E4%BB%8B)则把这种方法放回信乐的陶艺语境。

参展艺术家芹野直子长期使用黄麻，强调纤维能够呈现的生长感与结构感。[工艺艺术组织的作品介绍](https://artkogei.com/2026-artist5/)记录了她的《醸す-4》；[她另一场展览的资料](https://wa-gallery.art/exhibitions-single13.html)则描述了材料、模具与光线的关系。

谷穹对器物与人的关系，早在其他展览中就有不同呈现。2015 年，评论人高嶋慈在 [artscape 的展评](https://artscape.jp/report/review/author/10109108_1838,1,list1,128.html)中记录，观众可以为陈列的器物插花，也能选择茶碗，在临时茶室中使用它们。谷穹在 [2021 年画廊访谈](https://www.jilldart.com/2021/10/01/artistinterview_08/)里回忆，自己曾学习雕塑，后来重新研究中世信乐陶器的形态与气息。这两段旧材料让这次展览多了一层背景：器物既承载制作痕迹，也会在使用和观看中继续获得意义。

这场展览最有意思的地方，是邀请观众放慢对“传统工艺”的判断。陶、纤维和香各有历史，但它们在一个具体空间里相遇时，也会产生新的距离和节奏。关于谷穹的[访谈](https://monolab.tokyo/articles/12945)和一篇[工艺展览报道](https://www.kogeistandard.com/jp/insight/serial/exhibition-event-report/2024-11-25/)让这些实践有了更长的时间线；短暂展期结束后，值得带走的也许是这种观察材料的耐心。
stories.enMarkdown:
From November 8–10, *Aikyakuko* brought craft works into the setting of Ginkakuji in Kyoto, taking the appreciation of incense as a conceptual point of reference. The [organiser's announcement](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000026.000061898.html) is an entry point to an exhibition in which objects, light, architecture and the visitor's movement shape the encounter together.

Ceramic artist Tani Q's practice is a reminder that clay's final form emerges through a series of changes that cannot be fully controlled. An [earlier museum account](https://www.museum.kit.ac.jp/nap2014_qtani.html) discusses his attention to firing temperature and atmosphere; a [Kyoto gallery profile](https://www.galleryrinkyoto.com/post/%E4%BF%A1%E6%A5%BD-%E9%99%B6%E8%8A%B8%E5%AE%B6-%E8%B0%B7%E7%A9%B9-taniq-%E4%BD%9C%E5%AE%B6%E7%B4%B9%E4%BB%8B) locates his work in the context of Shigaraki ceramics. Knowing a process, however, does not reduce an individual object to its steps.

Fellow artist Naoko Serino has worked extensively with jute, attending to the growth-like forms and structures fibre can suggest. An [artist profile](https://artkogei.com/2026-artist5/) records her work *Kamosu-4*; material for [another exhibition](https://wa-gallery.art/exhibitions-single13.html) describes relationships between fibre, moulds and light, without claiming to document the making of every work in this show.

Tani’s interest in the relationship between objects and people has appeared in other exhibitions. In a [2015 artscape review](https://artscape.jp/report/review/author/10109108_1838,1,list1,128.html), critic Megumu Takashima described visitors arranging flowers in displayed vessels and choosing tea bowls for use in a temporary tea room. In a [2021 gallery interview](https://www.jilldart.com/2021/10/01/artistinterview_08/), Tani recalled studying sculpture before returning to ceramics and examining the forms and atmosphere of medieval Shigaraki ware. These earlier accounts show how an object carries the traces of making and acquires meaning through use and viewing.

The exhibition invites a slower response to the idea of traditional craft. Clay, fibre and incense each carry histories, yet their meeting in a specific place creates its own rhythm. An [interview with Tani](https://monolab.tokyo/articles/12945) and an [earlier craft-exhibition report](https://www.kogeistandard.com/jp/insight/serial/exhibition-event-report/2024-11-25/) give these practices a longer timeline. The lasting invitation is to look carefully at materials.

stories.title: 代官山 HYPER HYPER：独立创作者的线下相遇
stories.titleEn: HYPER HYPER brings independent creators together in Daikanyama
stories.zhDeck: 11 月 14 日至 15 日，代官山 ZA SPACE 计划举办 HYPER HYPER，把独立品牌、艺术家与来访者放进同一个临时空间。
stories.enDeck: HYPER HYPER is scheduled for 14–15 November at ZA SPACE in Daikanyama, bringing independent brands, artists and visitors into a temporary shared space.
stories.zhMarkdown:
11 月 14 日至 15 日，代官山 ZA SPACE 计划举办 HYPER HYPER，把独立品牌、艺术家与来访者放进同一个临时空间。主办人吉村说，他希望创作者和观众能直接交谈；参与艺术家 Pedro Nekoi 则从自己熟悉的东京街景谈起。 [Japan.co.jp](https://japan.co.jp/reports/hyper-hyper-tokyo-underground-fashion-art-daikanyama-2026.html) · [Japan Nakama](https://www.japannakama.co.uk/events/hyper-hyper-za-space-daikanyama/)

名字有一段跨城市的来历。吉村将东京活动命名为 HYPER HYPER，参考的是伦敦历史上的同名空间。设计师 Pam Hogg 在 2023 年回忆，那家伦敦店曾让年轻设计师有机会试卖作品；东京活动则由新的团队在代官山组织。 [主办者](https://hlvtcjp.com/en/blogs/hlvtc/hyper-hyper) · [French Fries](https://frenchfries-mag.com/interview/2023/5/11/pam-hogg-for-french-fries-6)

伦敦旧店给年轻设计师提供了入口，也有经营门槛。文化研究学者 Angela McRobbie 在 [2004 年收录的研究](https://www.ndl.ethernet.edu.et/bitstream/123456789/17825/1/17.pdf)中记录，1994 年 Hyper Hyper 的摊位月租达到 900 英镑；店方还要求申请者已有多个系列，并展示完整产品线。对一些设计师来说，摊位既能直接接触顾客，也意味着要自己承担库存和租金。这段历史让“独立空间”多了一层现实：有机会展示作品，仍要解决持续经营的问题。

Nekoi 的工作给这次相遇提供了另一条线索。他在过往采访中谈到把旧杂志、日本唱片封面和日常街景放进数字拼贴，也曾将图像印到亚克力，与灯光和物件一起展示。这些是他此前的项目。 [Creative Review](https://www.creativereview.co.uk/pedro-nekoi-illustration-digital-collage/) · [It's Nice That](https://www.itsnicethat.com/articles/pedro-nekoi-digital-discover-160724) · [Creative Boom](https://www.creativeboom.com/inspiration/pedro-nekoi-makes-surreal-saturated-worlds-from-traffic-cones-vintage-magazines-and-tokyo-backstreets/)

值得看的不是把伦敦的名字原封不动搬来，而是它能否在东京产生自己的关系：品牌、作品和人短暂共处，谈话本身也成为活动的一部分。海报由 Mars89 设计；他在较早的采访中谈过东京不同街区的夜生活。活动尚未举行，实际参与和长期影响都需要事后观察。 [Japan Nakama](https://www.japannakama.co.uk/events/hyper-hyper-za-space-daikanyama/) · [SILVER](https://silver-mag.jp/interview-with-mars89)
stories.enMarkdown:
HYPER HYPER is scheduled for 14–15 November at ZA SPACE in Daikanyama, bringing independent brands, artists and visitors into a temporary shared space. Organizer Yoshimura says he wants creators and visitors to talk directly; participating artist Pedro Nekoi describes working from the streets of Tokyo.  [Japan.co.jp](https://japan.co.jp/reports/hyper-hyper-tokyo-underground-fashion-art-daikanyama-2026.html) · [Japan Nakama](https://www.japannakama.co.uk/events/hyper-hyper-za-space-daikanyama/)

The name has a cross-city history. Yoshimura references the former London space of the same name. In a 2023 interview, designer Pam Hogg recalled how that shop gave young designers a place to try selling their work. The Tokyo event has its own organizers and venue; it is not a reopening of the London shop. [Organizer](https://hlvtcjp.com/en/blogs/hlvtc/hyper-hyper) · [French Fries](https://frenchfries-mag.com/interview/2023/5/11/pam-hogg-for-french-fries-6)

Nekoi's earlier practice offers another way in. He has described combining old magazines, Japanese record sleeves and everyday streets in digital collage, and has also printed images on acrylic for installations involving light and objects. These were earlier projects. [Creative Review](https://www.creativereview.co.uk/pedro-nekoi-illustration-digital-collage/) · [It's Nice That](https://www.itsnicethat.com/articles/pedro-nekoi-digital-discover-160724) · [Creative Boom](https://www.creativeboom.com/inspiration/pedro-nekoi-makes-surreal-saturated-worlds-from-traffic-cones-vintage-magazines-and-tokyo-backstreets/)

The London shop offered young designers a way in, but it also had financial and professional barriers. In a [study republished in 2004](https://www.ndl.ethernet.edu.et/bitstream/123456789/17825/1/17.pdf), cultural researcher Angela McRobbie recorded Hyper Hyper rents of £900 per month in 1994; applicants were expected to have developed multiple collections and present a full range. A stall put designers in direct contact with customers while leaving them responsible for rent and unsold stock. That history adds a practical question to the idea of an independent space: how can the opportunity to show work be sustained?

The question is what relationships the event can make in Tokyo: brands, objects and people sharing a place, with conversation as part of the encounter. Mars89 designed the poster. An earlier interview about Tokyo nightlife cannot stand in for an account of this particular image. Attendance and longer-term effects remain to be seen. [Japan Nakama](https://www.japannakama.co.uk/events/hyper-hyper-za-space-daikanyama/) · [SILVER](https://silver-mag.jp/interview-with-mars89)

stories.title: Black Belt Eagle Scout 新曲 Fantasy
stories.titleEn: Black Belt Eagle Scout returns with “Fantasy”
stories.zhDeck: Black Belt Eagle Scout 带着新歌《Fantasy》回归。
stories.enDeck: Black Belt Eagle Scout returns with the new song Fantasy.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Black Belt Eagle Scout 带着新歌《Fantasy》回归。[Our Culture 的报道](https://ourculturemag.com/black-belt-eagle-scout-returns-with-new-song-fantasy/)介绍，歌曲影像与来自阿拉斯加 Kotzebue 的 Iñupiaq 家人和舞者有关，由 Priscilla Hensley 与 Evan Benally Atwood 执导。

[Under the Radar](https://undertheradarmag.com/news/black_belt_eagle_scout_share_video_for_new_song_fantasy)记录了歌曲从语音备忘录和吉他出发，以及与制作人 Claire Glass、Nay Mapalo 的合作。这些创作细节来自艺术家发布的说明。

对 Katherine Paul 而言，家庭与共同创作并非突然出现的新主题。[2023 年 Our Culture 采访](https://ourculturemag.com/2023/02/16/artist-spotlight-black-belt-eagle-scout/)谈到她与艺术家 Camas Logue、摄影师 Atwood 等人的合作；[Them 的旧采访](https://www.them.us/story/black-belt-eagle-scout-the-land-the-water-the-sky)记录了家人在早期作品中的声音。

她对共同创作的关注也延伸到影像之外的学习过程。2019 年，Paul 向 [KEXP](https://kexp.org/read/2019/8/30/strength-resilience-black-belt-eagle-scout/) 讲述拍摄旧作《My Heart Dreams》时，她想让原住民女孩组成影像中的乐队，于是安排音乐课，教她们演奏那首歌。到了 2023 年，[美联社在 Pitchfork 音乐节采访](https://www.arabtimesonline.com/uploads/imported_images/pdf/2023/jul/31/ATKWT20230731.pdf)中记录，Claire Glass 已担任她乐队的吉他手，并谈到 Paul 的舞台表现。两段旧经历让这次的制作名单有了更长的协作背景。

在大都会艺术博物馆近期的[人物文章](https://www.metmuseum.org/pt/perspectives/black-belt-eagle-scout-resonant-sound-and-heritage)中，Paul 也谈到音乐、独木舟与舞蹈和文化传承之间的关系。[2018 年 Fader 采访](https://www.thefader.com/2018/09/14/black-belt-eagle-scout-mother-of-my-children-saddle-creek-interview)则让我们看到更早的音乐与家庭背景。把新歌放到这条时间线上，会发现协作并不只是名单上的名字：它也关乎谁能一起讲述、表演和保存记忆。
stories.enMarkdown:
Black Belt Eagle Scout returns with the new song *Fantasy*. [Our Culture](https://ourculturemag.com/black-belt-eagle-scout-returns-with-new-song-fantasy/) reports that its video involves Iñupiaq family members and dancers from Kotzebue, Alaska, and was directed by Priscilla Hensley and Evan Benally Atwood. 

[Under the Radar](https://undertheradarmag.com/news/black_belt_eagle_scout_share_video_for_new_song_fantasy) describes the song beginning with a voice memo and guitar, and collaboration with producers Claire Glass and Nay Mapalo. These details come from the artist's release statement.

For Katherine Paul, family and collective work are not new themes. A [2023 Our Culture interview](https://ourculturemag.com/2023/02/16/artist-spotlight-black-belt-eagle-scout/) discusses work with artist Camas Logue and photographer Atwood; an [older Them interview](https://www.them.us/story/black-belt-eagle-scout-the-land-the-water-the-sky) records family voices on an earlier release. 

Her interest in collaboration has also involved learning together. In a [2019 KEXP interview](https://kexp.org/read/2019/8/30/strength-resilience-black-belt-eagle-scout/), Paul recalled wanting an all-Indigenous girls’ band in the video for her earlier song *My Heart Dreams*, so she arranged music lessons and taught the participants to play it. At the 2023 Pitchfork Music Festival, [Associated Press reporting](https://www.arabtimesonline.com/uploads/imported_images/pdf/2023/jul/31/ATKWT20230731.pdf) recorded Claire Glass as the band’s guitarist and included her view of Paul’s stage presence. These earlier experiences give the new production credits a longer history of collaboration.

In a recent [Metropolitan Museum of Art profile](https://www.metmuseum.org/pt/perspectives/black-belt-eagle-scout-resonant-sound-and-heritage), Paul discusses music, canoes, dance and cultural inheritance. A [2018 Fader interview](https://www.thefader.com/2018/09/14/black-belt-eagle-scout-mother-of-my-children-saddle-creek-interview) offers earlier musical and family context. Across that timeline, collaboration is more than names on a credit: it also concerns who gets to tell, perform and carry memory together.

stories.zhMarkdown:
Salomon 与 BEAMS 把一只类似滑雪装备的扣具放到 XT-QUEST GTX 上。鞋款属于双方以「Hybridisation」为主题的合作，系列还包括服装与配件。BEAMS 公布的日本发售安排从 11 月 6 日原宿先行开始；不同国家和渠道有各自日期，不能写成全球同日上市。 [BEAMS](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5078/) · [Salomon 美国](https://www.salomon.com/en-us/product/xt-quest-gtx-beams-li9703/L45459900)

扣具盖在鞋带上，但没有把鞋带系统拿掉。Salomon 商品页列有 Quicklace；GQ 的产品报道同样描述扣具下保留鞋带。买手在一篇标注商业合作的采访中说，团队反复调整了扣具规格；这是参与者对设计过程的说明，不是穿着或防水效果的独立测试。 [Salomon](https://www.salomon.com/en-us/product/xt-quest-gtx-beams-li9703/L45459900) · [GQ](https://www.gq-magazine.co.uk/article/beams-salomon-xt-quest-gtx-5-11-26) · [HOUYHNHNM](https://www.houyhnhnm.jp/en/news/1184887/)

“Hybridisation”也延伸到了鞋以外。鞋履媒体介绍，同系列夹克在背部加入类似背包的拉链袋，与尼龙长裤、T 恤、帽子和可收纳托特包共同组成一套服装与配件。扣具出现在鞋上，背包式收纳出现在衣服上，户外装备的细节被重新分配到日常穿着中。[Footwear Magazine](https://footwearmagazine.com/salomon-beams-xt-quest-hybridisation-november-2026/)；[BEAMS 夹克商品页](https://www.beams.co.jp/item/beams/blouson/11189151757/?color=19)。

XT-QUEST 也有自己的户外历史。Salomon 在品牌档案中把它放在背包旅行和结实鞋履的语境中；The Broken Arm 合伙人 Romain 则在旧访谈里回忆，双方早年为一款已停产的 XT-Quest 2 重新开启模具。另一位 Salomon 负责人在 2018 年谈到更早的 Snowcross 合作。这些项目展示了 XT-QUEST 与其他合作系列各自的设计背景。 [Salomon 档案](https://www.salomon.com/en-fi/sg/a/news-gcs-acs-diving-the-salomon-archives) · [Kolroy Studio](https://www.kolroystudio.com/post/interview-with-romain-co-founder-of-the-broken-arm) · [Altitude Sports](https://www.altitude-sports.com/blog/interview-with-jean-philippe-lalonde-salomon)

OCEANS 报道还提到买手寻找扣件和雪上服装格纹的过程，其部分说法与品牌合作专题接近，需要按当事人陈述来读。鞋上的扣具让运动装备的结构变得醒目；它在日常行走或恶劣天气中表现如何，现有资料还不能回答。 [OCEANS](https://oceans.tokyo.jp/article/detail/55892?hamburger=_newpick)

这次混搭也放进了 Salomon 自己正在讨论的矛盾里。创意总监 Heikki Salonen 在 2026 年 9 月接受《Vogue》采访时说，品牌应继续从运动表现出发，并希望减少时尚、生活方式与户外产品之间的割裂。他谈的是 Salomon 的整体方向。[Vogue 专访](https://www.vogue.com/article/salomon-should-not-be-a-fashion-brand-the-new-creative-director-shares-his-manifesto)
stories.enMarkdown:
Salomon and BEAMS place a buckle reminiscent of ski equipment on the XT-QUEST GTX. The shoe belongs to a collaboration called “Hybridisation,” which also includes clothing and accessories. BEAMS announced an initial Harajuku release on 6 November; dates vary by country and retailer, so they should not be treated as a single global launch. [BEAMS](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5078/) · [Salomon US](https://www.salomon.com/en-us/product/xt-quest-gtx-beams-li9703/L45459900)

The buckle covers the lacing but does not remove it. Salomon lists Quicklace on its product page, and GQ also describes the laces under the buckle. In a marked commercial partnership, BEAMS buyers say the buckle specifications went through repeated adjustments. That is a participant's account of design, not an independent wear or waterproofing test. [Salomon](https://www.salomon.com/en-us/product/xt-quest-gtx-beams-li9703/L45459900) · [GQ](https://www.gq-magazine.co.uk/article/beams-salomon-xt-quest-gtx-5-11-26) · [HOUYHNHNM](https://www.houyhnhnm.jp/en/news/1184887/)

“Hybridisation” extends beyond the shoe. Footwear Magazine describes a jacket with a backpack-like zipped pouch on its back, joined by nylon trousers, a T-shirt, cap and packable tote in the wider collection. A buckle moves onto footwear while a pack-like pocket appears on clothing: details associated with outdoor equipment are redistributed across everyday pieces. [Footwear Magazine](https://footwearmagazine.com/salomon-beams-xt-quest-hybridisation-november-2026/); [BEAMS jacket listing](https://www.beams.co.jp/item/beams/blouson/11189151757/?color=19).

The XT-QUEST has an outdoor history of its own. Salomon's archive places it in a tradition of sturdy backpacking footwear. In an earlier interview, The Broken Arm cofounder Romain recalled reopening a mold for a discontinued XT-Quest 2; a Salomon executive discussed the still earlier Snowcross partnership in 2018. These earlier accounts describe the histories of separate projects. [Salomon archive](https://www.salomon.com/en-fi/sg/a/news-gcs-acs-diving-the-salomon-archives) · [Kolroy Studio](https://www.kolroystudio.com/post/interview-with-romain-co-founder-of-the-broken-arm) · [Altitude Sports](https://www.altitude-sports.com/blog/interview-with-jean-philippe-lalonde-salomon)

OCEANS also reports on the search for a buckle and checks drawn from snow clothing. Some buyer statements overlap with the branded feature and should be read as the collaborators' own account. The closure makes a piece of sports equipment conspicuous on the shoe; how it performs in daily use remains untested here. [OCEANS](https://oceans.tokyo.jp/article/detail/55892?hamburger=_newpick)

The collaboration also sits within a question Salomon is asking itself. In a September 2026 Vogue interview, creative director Heikki Salonen said the brand should continue to begin with performance and reduce the separation between fashion, lifestyle and outdoor products. He was describing the brand’s overall direction. [Vogue interview](https://www.vogue.com/article/salomon-should-not-be-a-fashion-brand-the-new-creative-director-shares-his-manifesto)

stories.title: BEAMS × Crocs：把横须贺夹克和飞行夹克穿到脚上
stories.titleEn: BEAMS and Crocs turn two jackets into clogs
stories.zhDeck: 一只洞洞鞋缝上刺绣，另一只把飞行夹克的橙色内衬和袖袋移到鞋面。
stories.enDeck: One clog receives embroidery; another moves an orange flight-jacket lining and sleeve pocket onto footwear.
stories.zhMarkdown:
一只洞洞鞋缝上刺绣，另一只把飞行夹克的橙色内衬和袖袋移到鞋面。BEAMS 与 Crocs 的新合作把横须贺夹克和 MA-1 的细节改写成两款鞋。日本新宿先行安排在 11 月 13 日，BEAMS 与 Crocs 的其他渠道随后分批发售。 [BEAMS](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5094/) · [Crocs Japan](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000259.000023595.html)

双方此前已经玩过类似转换。2021 年的第四次合作就有 MA-1 Jacket Clog；2024 年的报道则记录过横须贺夹克刺绣和骑士夹克元素。2026 年的意思是继续重做这些服装符号，而不是第一次把夹克搬上鞋。 [BEAMS 2021](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/2511/) · [eye_C](https://www.eyecmag.com/news/2024/9/4/beams-and-crocs-embody-the-essence-of-quintissential-american-casual-wear)

横须贺夹克的图案本来就有跨文化的流动。莱顿国际亚洲研究所的文章追溯日本裁缝、驻日美军与纪念性刺绣之间的关系；横须贺美术馆的旧展资料记录了龙、鹰和富士山等图案与机绣。历史展品的工艺不能自动套到这双新鞋上，但它解释了为什么夹克表面本身就是故事的一部分。 [IIAS](https://www.iias.asia/the-newsletter/article/sukajan-crossing-cultures) · [横须贺美术馆](https://www.yokosuka-moa.jp/static/file/press/2022/sukajan.pdf)

MA-1 则给了设计师另一套线索。伦敦博物馆梳理过飞行夹克从军用装备进入青年穿着的历史，后期一些可翻转版本的橙色内衬与搜救有关。鞋面上的口袋和颜色是对服装结构的引用，不意味着它们保留了原夹克的用途。 [伦敦博物馆](https://www.londonmuseum.org.uk/blog/bomber-jackets-from-military-gear-to-fashion-icon/) · [BEAMS](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5094/)

进一步看这两件夹克的流通，不能只停在图案好看。时尚研究者 Sarah Cheang 与 Elizabeth Kramer 在关于横须贺夹克的章节里指出，战后纪念夹克从为驻日军人定制，发展到由曾从事和服行业的工匠参与更大规模生产；作者也提醒，流行叙事容易淡化占领时期的不平等与暴力。安特卫普时装博物馆则梳理了 MA-1 后来在不同青年群体和设计师手中的变化。这些是服装史，不是本次鞋款的产地或制作证明。[RCA 学术存档](https://researchonline.rca.ac.uk/6082/1/03.chapter.Cheang%26Kramer%20%20.pdf) · [MoMu](https://www.momu.be/en/magazine/collection-presentation-bomber-jacket)
stories.enMarkdown:
One clog receives embroidery; another moves an orange flight-jacket lining and sleeve pocket onto footwear. The new BEAMS and Crocs collaboration translates details from the sukajan souvenir jacket and MA-1 into two shoes. The Shinjuku advance release is scheduled for 13 November, followed by other BEAMS and Crocs Japan channels on different dates. [BEAMS](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5094/) · [Crocs Japan](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000259.000023595.html)

The pair has explored the conversion before. Their fourth collaboration in 2021 included an MA-1 Jacket Clog, and a 2024 report documented souvenir-jacket embroidery and biker-jacket elements. The 2026 shoes continue that vocabulary rather than introducing it for the first time. [BEAMS 2021](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/2511/) · [eye_C](https://www.eyecmag.com/news/2024/9/4/beams-and-crocs-embody-the-essence-of-quintissential-american-casual-wear)

The sukajan itself carries a history of movement between cultures. An International Institute for Asian Studies essay traces relationships among Japanese tailors, US servicemen and souvenir embroidery; a Yokosuka Museum exhibition documented motifs including dragons, eagles and Mount Fuji. The historical process cannot automatically be assigned to the new footwear, but it shows why the jacket's surface carries stories. [IIAS](https://www.iias.asia/the-newsletter/article/sukajan-crossing-cultures) · [Yokosuka Museum](https://www.yokosuka-moa.jp/static/file/press/2022/sukajan.pdf)

The MA-1 supplies a different set of references. The London Museum traces the flight jacket's path from military clothing into youth fashion; some later reversible versions used orange linings associated with rescue visibility. The pocket and color on a clog quote the clothing's construction without necessarily retaining its original function. [London Museum](https://www.londonmuseum.org.uk/blog/bomber-jackets-from-military-gear-to-fashion-icon/) · [BEAMS](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5094/)

The movement of these jackets is more complicated than an attractive graphic. In a chapter on the sukajan, fashion scholars Sarah Cheang and Elizabeth Kramer trace its development from commissioned souvenirs for US service members to larger-scale production involving craftspeople with kimono-industry backgrounds. They also caution that popular heritage stories can obscure inequality and violence during the occupation. Antwerp’s fashion museum traces later reinterpretations of the MA-1 by different youth communities and designers. These are histories of garments, not evidence of where or how the new clogs were made. [RCA research archive](https://researchonline.rca.ac.uk/6082/1/03.chapter.Cheang%26Kramer%20%20.pdf) · [MoMu](https://www.momu.be/en/magazine/collection-presentation-bomber-jacket)

stories.title: Carhartt WIP × Nike Goadome Low：工装与靴鞋再相遇
stories.titleEn: Carhartt WIP and Nike bring workwear to the Goadome Low
stories.zhDeck: Carhartt WIP 与 Nike 把 Air Max Goadome 做成低帮，皮革、帆布、金属鞋带环和气垫放在同一双鞋上。
stories.enDeck: Carhartt WIP and Nike have made the Air Max Goadome into a low shoe, combining leather, canvas, metal lace hardware and an Air unit.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Carhartt WIP 与 Nike 把 Air Max Goadome 做成低帮，皮革、帆布、金属鞋带环和气垫放在同一双鞋上。合作还包括服装：日本 Carhartt WIP 介绍，夹克将 Nike Windrunner 的人字形拼色与 Active Jacket 的帆布、袋鼠袋和缝线结合。 [Carhartt WIP](https://us.carhartt-wip.com/en-us/collections/collaborations-nike-x-carhartt-wip) · [Carhartt WIP 日本](https://carhartt-wip.jp/blogs/journal/carhartt-wip-x-nike-fall-winter-2026-collection-1)

发售不能只写一个日期。Carhartt 北美与 Nike SNKRS 列出的渠道、配色与时间不同；GQ 报道将 11 月 12 日和 11 月 20 日分开。读者需要按所在地区和想买的配色查看官方页面，这两个时间不代表全球同步上市。 [GQ](https://www.gq-magazine.co.uk/article/carhartt-wip-nike-goadome-low-16-10-26) · [Nike SNKRS](https://www.nike.com/launch/t/air-max-goadome-low-carhartt-wip-black-and-twilight-marsh)

这不是两方第一次合作。Gear Patrol 把这次低帮鞋与 2018 年合作放在一起，并描述皮革、帆布与双缝线；报道带购物导向，不能替代穿着测试。Carhartt WIP 的历史页把品牌放进与滑板及音乐相连的欧洲街头语境。 [Gear Patrol](https://www.gearpatrol.com/footwear/nike-carhartt-air-max-goadome-low-wip/) · [Carhartt WIP 历史](https://www.carhartt-wip.com/en-gb/i/history?cl=true&country=GB)

Goadome 的形状也处在运动鞋与靴子之间。Inverse 在讨论旧款时转述设计师 Carl Blakeslee 把球鞋语言带入靴子的回忆；关于早期年份的资料有出入，这里不确定具体首发年。新合作重新组合工装织物和鞋靴结构，一张产品图不足以证明其户外性能。 [Inverse](https://www.inverse.com/input/style/supreme-nike-goadome-air-max-95-release-info) · [Sneaker News](https://sneakernews.com/2026/11/06/carhartt-wip-nike-goadome-release-date/)

早年的合作提供了一个具体对照：2018 年双方把工装帆布与虎纹防撕裂面料放到 Air Force 1、Air Max 95 和 Vandal 等鞋型上。[Gear Patrol 当年报道](https://www.gearpatrol.com/fitness/a534110/nike-carhartt-wips-collaboration/)列出了这些旧款；Carhartt WIP 的 Alex Morris 在零售商 [size? 的 2020 年访谈](https://blog.size.co.uk/2020/05/27/size-collections-alex-morris-carhartt-work-in-progress/)回忆其中的 Air Max 95 使用迷彩、防撕裂布和灯芯绒。这些是 2018 年的材料，不应自动套用到 2026 年 Goadome。
stories.enMarkdown:
Carhartt WIP and Nike have made the Air Max Goadome into a low shoe, combining leather, canvas, metal lace hardware and an Air unit. The collection also includes clothing: Carhartt WIP Japan describes a jacket bringing the Nike Windrunner chevron together with Active Jacket canvas, a kangaroo pocket and stitching. [Carhartt WIP](https://us.carhartt-wip.com/en-us/collections/collaborations-nike-x-carhartt-wip) · [Carhartt WIP Japan](https://carhartt-wip.jp/blogs/journal/carhartt-wip-x-nike-fall-winter-2026-collection-1)

There is no single date to apply everywhere. Carhartt North America and Nike SNKRS list different channels, colorways and dates; GQ separates 12 and 20 November. Check the relevant regional page for the specific shoe rather than assuming both dates describe a global launch. [GQ](https://www.gq-magazine.co.uk/article/carhartt-wip-nike-goadome-low-16-10-26) · [Nike SNKRS](https://www.nike.com/launch/t/air-max-goadome-low-carhartt-wip-black-and-twilight-marsh)

The two have worked together before. Gear Patrol places the low shoe alongside their 2018 collaboration and describes its leather, canvas and double stitching; its shopping-oriented report is not a wear test. Carhartt WIP's history places the brand in a European streetwear context connected to skateboarding and music. [Gear Patrol](https://www.gearpatrol.com/footwear/nike-carhartt-air-max-goadome-low-wip/) · [Carhartt WIP history](https://www.carhartt-wip.com/en-gb/i/history?cl=true&country=GB)

The Goadome sits between sneaker and boot. In a report about an earlier version, Inverse repeats designer Carl Blakeslee's recollection of bringing sneaker language to a boot. Sources disagree over an early release year, so it is left open here. This collaboration recombines workwear fabric with footwear construction; a product image cannot establish its outdoor performance. [Inverse](https://www.inverse.com/input/style/supreme-nike-goadome-air-max-95-release-info) · [Sneaker News](https://sneakernews.com/2026/11/06/carhartt-wip-nike-goadome-release-date/)

The earlier partnership offers a specific comparison. In 2018 the brands placed workwear canvas and tiger-camouflage ripstop on silhouettes including the Air Force 1, Air Max 95 and Vandal, as [Gear Patrol reported at the time](https://www.gearpatrol.com/fitness/a534110/nike-carhartt-wips-collaboration/). In a [2020 interview with retailer size?](https://blog.size.co.uk/2020/05/27/size-collections-alex-morris-carhartt-work-in-progress/), Carhartt WIP’s Alex Morris recalled camouflage, ripstop and corduroy on the Air Max 95. Those are details of the 2018 shoe and should not be transferred automatically to the 2026 Goadome.

stories.title: Rick Owens × adidas：叶片鞋底回到跑鞋
stories.titleEn: Rick Owens and adidas bring back the Springblade sole
stories.zhDeck: Rick Owens 与 adidas 再次合作，Springblade 鞋底的叶片结构重新出现在鞋履中。
stories.enDeck: Rick Owens and adidas are working together again, bringing the blade-like Springblade sole back into footwear.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Rick Owens 与 adidas 再次合作，Springblade 鞋底的叶片结构重新出现在鞋履中。新进展是一篇 11 月 9 日的设计师采访：相关系列此前已在巴黎秀场出现，并非这一天才首次露面。 [Vogue](https://www.vogue.com/article/rick-owens-adidas-collaboration) · [Vogue 秀场报道](https://www.vogue.com/article/rick-owens-adidas-collab-spring-2027-paris-mens)

叶片改变了鞋与地面之间的视觉关系：鞋底被分成一组连续的支撑，而不是一整块厚底。GQ 在 6 月秀场报道中把这次合作与双方此前作品联系起来。秀场照片和发布报道不足以证明脚感、耐久性或运动表现。 [GQ](https://www.gq.com/story/rick-owens-adidas-collaboration-2026)

这条合作线已经延续多年。Owens 官网转载的 2014 年采访提到他当时的品牌工作和 Springblade；它不能充当他对 2026 新鞋的解释。鞋履报道列出本次款式及 11 月中旬日期，但具体产品与地区仍需以对应渠道为准。 [Owens 官网](https://www.rickowens.eu/en-row/blogs/interviews/the-ongoing-transformation-of-rick-owens-september-2014) · [Sole Retriever](https://www.soleretriever.com/news/articles/rick-owens-adidas-fall-2026-release-date-november-2026)

巴黎秀场的服装也在处理身体与装备的关系。Wallpaper* 注意到风扇结构；这些是秀场观察，不代表它们属于本次在售鞋款。熟悉的运动技术被放进 Owens 的轮廓，形成一个值得重新观看的旧结构。 [Wallpaper*](https://www.wallpaper.com/fashion-beauty/best-shows-paris-fashion-week-mens-ss-2027)

这次重访也有一条可追溯的运动鞋设计史。2014 年《Interview》报道双方的 Tech Runner，把它视为另一个既有运动品牌轮廓与 Owens 设计语言的结合；2016 年《Footwear News》对 Owens 的访问记录了他改造 adidas Pro Model 的做法。两篇讨论的是各自的旧款，不说明 2026 Springblade 的具体材料或表现。[Interview](https://www.interviewmagazine.com/fashion/rick-owens-x-adidas-takes-off) · [Footwear News，设计师官网重刊](https://www.rickowens.eu/blogs/interviews/how-rick-owens-is-using-sneakers-to-fuel-his-growing-empire-june-27-2016)

这双鞋的旧版还和舞蹈有关：2014 年的 2015 春夏男装秀以《牧神午后》为线索，《Vogue》当时的秀评把 Springblade 与牧神的足部形象联系起来。另一篇 i-D 后台采访记录了 Owens 如何把身边艺术家的画转成刺绣，并用轻薄运动面料组织整场秀。它们提供的是旧系列的创作语境，不代表 2026 鞋款沿用了相同叙事。[Vogue 2014 秀评](https://www.vogue.com/fashion-shows/spring-2015-menswear/rick-owens) · [i-D 后台报道](https://i-d.co/article/rick-owens-springsummer-15/)
stories.enMarkdown:
Rick Owens and adidas are working together again, bringing the blade-like Springblade sole back into footwear. The immediate new development is a designer interview published on 9 November; the related collection had already appeared on a Paris runway. [Vogue](https://www.vogue.com/article/rick-owens-adidas-collaboration) · [Vogue runway report](https://www.vogue.com/article/rick-owens-adidas-collab-spring-2027-paris-mens)

The blades change the visible relationship between shoe and ground: the sole reads as a series of supports rather than one continuous block. GQ's June runway report connects the collection to earlier work. Neither runway images nor launch coverage substitute for a test of comfort, durability or athletic performance. [GQ](https://www.gq.com/story/rick-owens-adidas-collaboration-2026)

The partnership has a longer history. Owens's site republishes a 2014 interview in which he discussed his business and Springblade; those words cannot stand in for his explanation of the 2026 shoe. A footwear report lists current styles and mid-November dates, but availability should be checked for each product and region. [Owens site](https://www.rickowens.eu/en-row/blogs/interviews/the-ongoing-transformation-of-rick-owens-september-2014) · [Sole Retriever](https://www.soleretriever.com/news/articles/rick-owens-adidas-fall-2026-release-date-november-2026)

The Paris clothing also explored body and equipment. Wallpaper* noted fan structures in the show; this is a runway observation, not a claim about the shoes on sale. A familiar sports technology has been placed back into Owens's silhouettes. [Wallpaper*](https://www.wallpaper.com/fashion-beauty/best-shows-paris-fashion-week-mens-ss-2027)

The return also sits within a traceable footwear history. In 2014, Interview covered the partners’ Tech Runner as a meeting of an athletic silhouette and Owens’ design language. A 2016 Footwear News interview recorded his reworking of the adidas Pro Model. These accounts concern earlier shoes; they do not establish the materials or performance of the 2026 Springblade. [Interview](https://www.interviewmagazine.com/fashion/rick-owens-x-adidas-takes-off) · [Footwear News, republished by the designer](https://www.rickowens.eu/blogs/interviews/how-rick-owens-is-using-sneakers-to-fuel-his-growing-empire-june-27-2016)

The earlier shoe also had a connection to dance. The Spring 2015 menswear show, presented in 2014, took L’Après-Midi d’un Faune as a reference; Vogue’s contemporary review connected the Springblade to the faun’s feet. An i-D backstage report recorded how Owens turned drawings by an artist close to his team into embroidery and used lightweight performance fabrics across the show. These sources describe the earlier collection, not the stated inspiration for the 2026 shoes. [Vogue runway review, 2014](https://www.vogue.com/fashion-shows/spring-2015-menswear/rick-owens) · [i-D backstage report](https://i-d.co/article/rick-owens-springsummer-15/)

stories.title: 电气 Groove × atmos × Crocs：唱片进入鞋底
stories.titleEn: Denki Groove, atmos and Crocs put a record into footwear
stories.zhDeck: 电气 Groove、atmos 与 Crocs 把唱片视觉和鞋履放到同一个物件上。
stories.enDeck: Denki Groove, atmos and Crocs have brought record imagery and footwear into one object.
stories.zhMarkdown:
电气 Groove、atmos 与 Crocs 把唱片视觉和鞋履放到同一个物件上。品牌 11 月 9 日发布的图文介绍 Echo 系列合作，FASHIONSNAP 将线索指向乐队专辑《VOXXX》；鞋饰和包装中的音乐符号，是这次值得细看的部分。 [品牌发布](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000916.000063811.html) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-09/atmos-denki-groove-crocs-echoii/)

这项合作此前已有预告，11 月 12 日巡演现场的先行安排不代表全球同日上市。不同渠道与时间应以对应品牌通知为准。产品照片帮助识别设计，不能单凭它判断穿着感受。 [atmos](https://www.atmos-tokyo.com/lp/crocs-echo-2-denkigroove-atmos) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-09/atmos-denki-groove-crocs-echoii/)

把《VOXXX》放回乐队历史，可以看到另一层背景。两位成员在 2015 年采访中回忆，专辑之后一度难以决定下一步的方向，后来新的配乐委托带来了工作起点。这段旧访谈不能写成他们为这双鞋选择视觉的理由。 [Real Sound](https://realsound.jp/movie/2015/12/post-643.html)

《VOXXX》的音乐也有自己的来路。在 [2026 年 J-WAVE 对谈](https://news.j-wave.co.jp/2026/10/content-5641.amp.html)中，两位成员回忆，专辑收录的《FLASHBACK DISCO》是在一名成员离开后，围绕他们喜欢的低音线与合成器创作的。石野说，他在自己的录音室和柏林录音室前后做了大约一年。这段回忆让鞋履所借用的唱片图像有了更具体的音乐背景。

在 [2008 年《CDJournal》双人采访](https://www.cdjournal.com/cdjpush/denki-groove/1000000105)中，石野回忆《VOXXX》制作时期的混乱，并说后来制作《J-POP》时，作品的轮廓在录音开始前已大致确定。谈到唱片作为实体物件，他在 [2014 年 Red Bull Music Academy 采访](https://daily.redbullmusicacademy.com/2014/10/takkyu-ishino-interview/)中说，自己作为购买者重视拿到唱片时的满足感，因此也从听众角度考虑封套设计。这是他对唱片设计的看法，也为这次将唱片图像带入鞋履提供了一条理解线索；访谈来自品牌支持的音乐项目。

从音乐史回看，电气 Groove 对流行与电子音乐边界的处理由来已久：1997 年《Billboard》的日本 techno 报道记录石野卓球当时对下一张唱片加入更多流行感的想法。到了 2008 年，他在《CDJournal》另一次采访中将《YELLOW》和当年早些时候的《J-POP》区分为两种不同的制作状态；这帮助理解乐队不断变化的表达，而不是证明这次鞋款由哪一首歌启发。[Billboard 1997](https://www.worldradiohistory.com/Archive-All-Music/Billboard/90s/1997/Billboard-1997-02-08.pdf) · [CDJournal 2008](https://www.cdjournal.com/cdjpush/denki-groove/1000000182)

乐队对实体物件的兴趣也不止于唱片。2024 年 [The Fashion Post 专访](https://fashionpost.jp/portraits/301862)里，石野卓球谈到自己喜欢购买音乐人周边，也喜欢制作想拥有的物件；他还回忆早期唱片封套受制作期限约束，后来逐渐能够寻找合拍的设计师。这里呈现的是他对周边和封套的一般态度，而非对 2026 年鞋款的专门解释。
stories.enMarkdown:
Denki Groove, atmos and Crocs have brought record imagery and footwear into one object. The brand's 9 November announcement presents an Echo collaboration; FASHIONSNAP connects the visual reference to the band's album *VOXXX*. The musical details in the charms and packaging are part of the design to look at closely. [Brand announcement](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000916.000063811.html) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-09/atmos-denki-groove-crocs-echoii/)

The collaboration had been teased before this announcement. An advance release at a tour stop on 12 November does not establish a worldwide launch; check the relevant retailer for local availability. Brand photographs help identify the design, but do not establish how the shoe feels to wear. [atmos](https://www.atmos-tokyo.com/lp/crocs-echo-2-denkigroove-atmos) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-09/atmos-denki-groove-crocs-echoii/)

The band's history supplies separate context. In a 2015 interview the members recalled uncertainty about what to do after *VOXXX*, and how a later soundtrack commission provided a new starting point. That conversation cannot be treated as their explanation for imagery on these shoes. [Real Sound](https://realsound.jp/movie/2015/12/post-643.html)

The music on *VOXXX* has its own history. In a [2026 J-WAVE conversation](https://news.j-wave.co.jp/2026/10/content-5641.amp.html), the two members recalled making “FLASHBACK DISCO,” which appears on the album, after a member left, building it around the basslines and synthesizers they liked. Ishino remembered working on it in his own studio and in Berlin over roughly a year. Their account adds a more specific musical background to the album imagery referenced by the shoes.

In a [2008 CDJournal interview](https://www.cdjournal.com/cdjpush/denki-groove/1000000105), Ishino recalled the turmoil around making *VOXXX* and said the outline of the later *J-POP* was largely in place before recording began. Discussing records as physical objects in a [2014 Red Bull Music Academy interview](https://daily.redbullmusicacademy.com/2014/10/takkyu-ishino-interview/), he said that, as a buyer, he valued the satisfaction of owning a record and considered the listener’s perspective when making covers. His remarks concern record design and provide one way to think about album imagery moving onto footwear. The interview comes from a brand-supported music project.

The group’s relationship with pop and electronic music has a longer history. A 1997 Billboard report on Japanese techno recorded Ishino’s expectation that the next Denki Groove album would have more of a pop feel. In a separate 2008 CDJournal interview, he contrasted the creative conditions behind Yellow with those of J-POP, released earlier that year. These accounts illuminate changing approaches to music; they do not identify a particular song as the source of the 2026 shoe. [Billboard, 1997](https://www.worldradiohistory.com/Archive-All-Music/Billboard/90s/1997/Billboard-1997-02-08.pdf) · [CDJournal, 2008](https://www.cdjournal.com/cdjpush/denki-groove/1000000182)

The group’s interest in physical objects extends beyond records. In a [2024 interview with The Fashion Post](https://fashionpost.jp/portraits/301862), Ishino spoke about enjoying both buying artist merchandise and making objects he would want to own. He also recalled the deadline constraints around early record sleeves and how the group gradually gained more room to seek out designers they connected with. These are general reflections on merchandise and cover design, not an explanation of the 2026 shoe.

stories.title: Danica Phelps：把住房债务与工作画成线
stories.titleEn: Danica Phelps draws the weight of a mortgage
stories.zhDeck: 一笔房贷，能占据多大的纸面？
stories.enDeck: How much paper can a mortgage occupy?
stories.zhMarkdown:
一笔房贷，能占据多大的纸面？在洛杉矶 Luis De Jesus 画廊的《Reach》中，Danica Phelps 将财务负担变成身体反复划出的细线。画廊所列的《North Mortgage》（2024–26）是一张约两米高、近三米宽的石墨纸本。展览于 11 月 7 日开幕，截止日期请以画廊最新公告为准。 [Luis De Jesus](https://www.luisdejesus.com/exhibitions/danica-phelps2)

展名里的“够到”也是一种动作。画廊介绍，Phelps 从身体中部出发，把手臂向上伸至极限，必要时踮起脚，再一遍遍画线。商业画廊 NF Galería 对该系列的说明，把贷款金额、重复动作与身体可及的范围联系起来；这是艺术家与画廊对创作方法的说明。 [NF Galería](https://nfgaleria.com/publicacion/dp-en/)

她并不是第一次把钱带入绘画。艺术家的网站回顾，她曾把每日收支、画作出售和再次交易一并记入作品。Eula Biss 在 2020 年《巴黎评论》的文章里解释过旧项目《Income’s Outcome》中的不同颜色如何对应收入、开销和信用；2014 年另一场展览也记录了作品与交易继续生成的过程。钱在这里既是主题，也是让作品不断变化的一套记录方式。 [Danica Phelps](https://www.danicaphelpsprojects.com/about) · [The Paris Review](https://www.theparisreview.org/blog/2020/09/08/is-it-too-scary/) · [Patrick Heide](https://www.patrickheide.com/exhibitions/incomes-outcome-part-four)

这套记录最初来自很实际的需要。Phelps 在 2016 年的访谈里回忆，她开始画下每笔开销，再把画贴到墙上，借此看清自己花了什么；绘画也让一次消费停留得更久。回看 2005 年《Wake》的展评，评论者 David Cohen 注意到她把日程和花费一起纳入记录，认为时间本身就是作品的一部分。从收支表到反复画线，数字与绘画劳动始终互相牵动。[Making and Being 访谈](https://makingandbeing.com/chapters/lifecycle-framework/transfer.html)；[artcritical 旧展评论](https://artcritical.com/2005/09/22/philip-pearlstein-at-betty-cuningham-and-danica-phelps-wake-at-zach-feuer/)。

不同年代的评论者从各自现场读到了不同侧面：Christine Hill 在 2005 年讨论彩色收支线条与日常生活，Leah Ollman 在 2008 年留意参与者手绘和署名，2018 年又讨论了绘画如何连接更大的环境与社会问题。回到《Reach》，一张大纸上的细线让借贷从数字变成可见的时间和动作；它并不替观众解决债务，却让承担债务所需的劳动有了尺度。 [BOMB](https://bombmagazine.org/articles/2005/04/01/danica-phelps/) · [Los Angeles Times, 2008](https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2008-mar-07-et-galleries7-story.html) · [Los Angeles Times, 2018](https://nfgaleria.com/sites/default/files/la_times_lives_on_the_line-_how_the_art_of_danica_phelps_takes_on_environmental_and_humanitarian_dimensions.pdf)
stories.enMarkdown:
How much paper can a mortgage occupy? In *Reach* at Luis De Jesus Los Angeles, Danica Phelps turns financial obligation into repeated marks made by a moving body. The gallery identifies *North Mortgage* (2024–26) as graphite on paper, roughly two metres high and almost three metres wide. The exhibition opened on November 7; its closing date should be confirmed with the gallery. [Luis De Jesus](https://www.luisdejesus.com/exhibitions/danica-phelps2)

The title also names a physical action. The gallery describes Phelps drawing each line from her centre and reaching as high as her arm allows, sometimes rising onto her toes. NF Galería connects the repeated gesture to the amount owed and to the body’s reach. The artist and galleries describe this as part of her process. [NF Galería](https://nfgaleria.com/publicacion/dp-en/)

Money has appeared in her work for decades. Her website describes recording daily expenses alongside sales and subsequent transactions. In 2020, Eula Biss discussed the different colours used for income, expenditure and credit in the earlier *Income’s Outcome*; a 2014 exhibition described how drawings and transactions continued to generate further records. Money is both a subject and a way for a work to keep changing. [Danica Phelps](https://www.danicaphelpsprojects.com/about) · [The Paris Review](https://www.theparisreview.org/blog/2020/09/08/is-it-too-scary/) · [Patrick Heide](https://www.patrickheide.com/exhibitions/incomes-outcome-part-four)

The record began with a practical need. In a 2016 interview, Phelps recalled drawing what she spent money on and putting the drawings on the wall so she could see the expenses; drawing also made each purchase linger in her attention. Reviewing her earlier *Wake* exhibition in 2005, critic David Cohen noticed how schedules and spending entered the same record and treated time itself as part of the work. From financial notes to repeated lines, numbers and the labor of drawing remain intertwined. [Making and Being interview](https://makingandbeing.com/chapters/lifecycle-framework/transfer.html); [artcritical review](https://artcritical.com/2005/09/22/philip-pearlstein-at-betty-cuningham-and-danica-phelps-wake-at-zach-feuer/).

Critics have approached different exhibitions from different angles: Christine Hill considered the lines and daily life in 2005; Leah Ollman wrote about participants’ hand-drawn marks in 2008 and wider social and environmental concerns in 2018. In *Reach*, the accumulation of marks gives the labour associated with debt a physical scale. [BOMB](https://bombmagazine.org/articles/2005/04/01/danica-phelps/) · [Los Angeles Times, 2008](https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2008-mar-07-et-galleries7-story.html) · [Los Angeles Times, 2018](https://nfgaleria.com/sites/default/files/la_times_lives_on_the_line-_how_the_art_of_danica_phelps_takes_on_environmental_and_humanitarian_dimensions.pdf)
