stories.title: 久保寛子：日常材料在雕塑中重组
stories.titleEn: Hiroko Kubo reshapes everyday materials
stories.zhDeck: 塑料、水泥、铁和网，到了久保寛子手里，会变成怎样的形体？
stories.enDeck: What can plastic, cement, iron and mesh become in Hiroko Kubo’s hands?
stories.zhMarkdown:
塑料、水泥、铁和网，到了久保寛子手里，会变成怎样的形体？纽约 Ulterior Gallery 的项目空间于 11 月 10 日至 12 月 19 日呈现她的《falling angel》，11 月 13 日举行开幕活动。画廊称这是艺术家与该画廊的首次个展，也是她在美国的展览首秀；页面上的图片记录的是她 2026 年千叶工作室，并非纽约展场。 [Ulterior Gallery](https://www.ulteriorgallery.com/hiroko-kubo-falling-angel)

在随展文字里，久保说自己取用身边的普通材料，像研究过去的人如何利用周遭资源一样，通过手的劳动寻找意料之外的可能。她把“坠落的天使”放在神圣与世俗、纯真与危险之间：倒转图像时，也可以想象它正在向上。这些材料与意象来自艺术家的随展说明。 [Ulterior Gallery](https://www.ulteriorgallery.com/hiroko-kubo-falling-angel) · [Hiroko Kubo](https://hirokokubo.net/texts)

她在其他城市的项目提供了认识这一方法的入口。2023 年，Museum.or.jp 的记者在富山记录一对蓝色的大型《やまいぬ》；久保在 2022 年名古屋项目《Statue of Hainuwele》中，则讨论泥土、神话以及作品在户外受到天气影响。2025 年爱知三年展的另一件大型作品，以及 Casa Wabi 驻留期间与大学社群一起做的印章、版画和陶土，显示她的工作不断改变地点和尺度。 [Museum.or.jp](https://www.museum.or.jp/report/113522) · [Streaming Heritage](https://www.creative-nagoya.jp/streamingheritage/en/program/kubo.html) · [Aichi Triennale](https://aichitriennale.jp/2025/artist/kubo-hiroko.html) · [Casa Wabi](https://casawabi.org/en/wabi_artist/hiroko-kubo/)

2024 年东京的《铁骨的女神》展示了她如何在日用品与神话之间工作。展前报道介绍，大型形体使用防风网，另有混凝土制成的护符和蓝色篷布制成的陶器形态作品；艺术家在当时的声明里说，她希望从现成材料中寻找新神话的碎片。此前在横滨呈现的《Hainuwele》则借用了印尼神话中的女神形象。材料在这里既保留工业产品的来历，也获得新的象征角色。[Time Out Tokyo](https://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/news/exhibition-by-sculptor-hiroko-kubo-032624)；[2024 年展览声明](https://www.pola.co.jp/about/news/2024/e0bv2n000000dq1a-att/po20240321.pdf)；[横滨三年展](https://www.yokohamatriennale.jp/2024/en/many-many-arts/5720/)。

《Numéro TOKYO》此前采访她时，久保谈到户外作品要面对雨、风和阳光；在《Popeye》的自述里，她也回看驻留经历与艺术能做什么的限度。把这两种声音放在纽约展的预告旁，能看到她持续关心的问题：雕塑不是从材料中抽离出来的纯粹形状，它会遇到天气、身体和历史。 [Numéro TOKYO](https://numero.jp/20260922-theartistfiles-12/) · [Popeye](https://popeyemagazine.jp/post-298750/)
stories.enMarkdown:
What can plastic, cement, iron and mesh become in Hiroko Kubo’s hands? Ulterior Gallery in New York presents *falling angel* from November 10 to December 19, with a reception on November 13. The gallery describes it as her first solo exhibition with the gallery and her U.S. exhibition debut. The image on its page shows her Chiba studio in 2026, not the New York installation. [Ulterior Gallery](https://www.ulteriorgallery.com/hiroko-kubo-falling-angel)

In the exhibition text, Kubo describes working with ordinary materials around her and discovering unexpected possibilities through physical labour. She places the “falling angel” between the sacred and the everyday, innocence and danger; when the image is inverted, she suggests, the figure may also appear to ascend. This is the artist’s account of the work. The installation itself still needs to be encountered. [Ulterior Gallery](https://www.ulteriorgallery.com/hiroko-kubo-falling-angel) · [Hiroko Kubo](https://hirokokubo.net/texts)

Earlier projects offer context without standing in for the New York show. A 2023 report described the large blue pair *Yamainu* in Toyama. For *Statue of Hainuwele* in Nagoya in 2022, Kubo discussed earth, myth and exposure to weather. Another large work appeared at Aichi Triennale in 2025; at Casa Wabi she also made stamps, prints and clay works with a university community. These projects show a practice that shifts location and scale. [Museum.or.jp](https://www.museum.or.jp/report/113522) · [Streaming Heritage](https://www.creative-nagoya.jp/streamingheritage/en/program/kubo.html) · [Aichi Triennale](https://aichitriennale.jp/2025/artist/kubo-hiroko.html) · [Casa Wabi](https://casawabi.org/en/wabi_artist/hiroko-kubo/)

Her 2024 Tokyo exhibition *Steel Framed Goddess* offers another view of how everyday materials meet mythology in her work. A preview described large forms using windbreak netting, alongside concrete amulets and pottery-like forms made with blue tarpaulin. In her statement for that exhibition, Kubo wrote of seeking fragments of new myths in materials already at hand. An earlier presentation of *Hainuwele* in Yokohama drew on an Indonesian goddess. The materials retain their industrial origins while acquiring new symbolic roles. [Time Out Tokyo](https://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/news/exhibition-by-sculptor-hiroko-kubo-032624); [2024 exhibition statement](https://www.pola.co.jp/about/news/2024/e0bv2n000000dq1a-att/po20240321.pdf); [Yokohama Triennale](https://www.yokohamatriennale.jp/2024/en/many-many-arts/5720/).

Speaking to *Numéro TOKYO*, Kubo described outdoor sculpture’s encounters with rain, wind and sun; in a *Popeye* essay she reflected on a residency and the limits of what art can do. Both point to an ongoing interest in material as something that meets weather, bodies and history. [Numéro TOKYO](https://numero.jp/20260922-theartistfiles-12/) · [Popeye](https://popeyemagazine.jp/post-298750/)

stories.title: Edward Burtynsky 的地表摄影抵达安塔利亚
stories.titleEn: Edward Burtynsky brings landscapes of human impact to Antalya
stories.zhDeck: 一张看起来近乎抽象的地表照片，靠近之后，可能会显出道路、矿场和人类活动的痕迹。
stories.enDeck: A photograph of the earth can look almost abstract until roads, mines and traces of human activity come into view.
stories.zhMarkdown:
一张看起来近乎抽象的地表照片，靠近之后，可能会显出道路、矿场和人类活动的痕迹。11 月 9 日至 20 日，摄影师 Edward Burtynsky 的《Shifting Topography》选集在土耳其安塔利亚 Akra 展出，并与 COP31 期间的活动相连。展览选自此前在伊斯坦布尔呈现的作品。 [Edward Burtynsky](https://www.edwardburtynsky.com/events/2026/11/9/edward-burtynsky-shifting-topography) · [Hürriyet Daily News](https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/amp/edward-burtynskys-shifting-topography-to-be-shown-at-cop31-in-antalya-228237)

合作方 Borusan 介绍，安塔利亚的呈现将其委托的安纳托利亚《Erosion》项目，与 22 分钟的多媒体作品《In the Wake of Progress》放在一起。后者结合影像与 Phil Strong 的音乐，是该作品首次在土耳其呈现。它为照片增加时间和声音，也让观看不只发生在一张静止的画面前。 [Borusan](https://www.borusan.com/en/news/presented-in-collaboration-with-borusan-holding-and-borusan-contemporary-the-edward-burtynsky-shifting-topography-special-selection-for-cop31-is-now-at-akra-antalya) · [Edward Burtynsky](https://www.edwardburtynsky.com/events/2026/11/9/edward-burtynsky-shifting-topography)

在展方此前的采访中，Burtynsky 说自己希望图像先以视觉吸引人，再让观众形成对地表变化的判断。摄影媒体对他的早年采访还记录，他在 1980 年代逐渐把镜头转向大规模人类活动。两篇采访勾勒出摄影师的工作方法。 [Borusan Contemporary](https://blog.borusancontemporary.com/en/blog-conversation-with-edward-burtynsky-photography-landscape-human-impact_2469) · [Amateur Photographer](https://amateurphotographer.com/technique/interviews/edward-burtynsky-an-incredible-insight-into-abstraction-extraction/)

对于 Burtynsky，取景并不是对现实的机械复制。在 PBS 的较早采访中，他谈到等待光线、观察纹理与季节，并从宽广的采石场里选择一个局部；这样的选择让平常的工业地貌获得新的形式。2022 年澳大利亚 ABC 报道《In the Wake of Progress》在悉尼的公共放映时，也记录了摄影师希望人们注意资源消耗与生态变化的想法。[PBS 采访文字稿](https://www.pbs.org/video/edward-burtynsky-iznoyj/)；[ABC 悉尼报道](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-09-02/edward-burtynsky-environment-photography-climate-change/101394660)。

这种美感也带来疑问。Helen Gordon 在 2024 年伦敦旧展评中讨论了先看到抽象构图、读说明后才意识到工业用途的落差；Burtynsky 在《卫报》采访里也回应过“是否让破坏变得好看”的问题。《艺术报》对 2025 年纽约回顾展的现场报道，则记录了不同尺寸和时期的照片如何并置。这些较早的展评与采访，提供了理解其作品的不同角度。 [Apollo](https://apollo-magazine.com/edward-burtynsky-photographs-environment-saatchi-gallery-review/) · [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/2025/jun/26/edward-burtynsky-photographs-exhibition) · [The Art Newspaper](https://www.theartnewspaper.com/2025/06/19/edward-burtynsky-great-acceleration-international-center-photography)
stories.enMarkdown:
A photograph of the earth can look almost abstract until roads, mines and traces of human activity come into view. From November 9 to 20, a selection from Edward Burtynsky’s *Shifting Topography* is presented at Akra Antalya during COP31. It is a selection from an earlier Istanbul exhibition, not evidence that every work has travelled or was newly made for this event. [Edward Burtynsky](https://www.edwardburtynsky.com/events/2026/11/9/edward-burtynsky-shifting-topography) · [Hürriyet Daily News](https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/amp/edward-burtynskys-shifting-topography-to-be-shown-at-cop31-in-antalya-228237)

Partner Borusan says the Antalya presentation combines the commissioned Anatolian *Erosion* project with *In the Wake of Progress*, a 22-minute multimedia work with music by Phil Strong, presented in Türkiye for the first time. It adds time and sound to the photographic encounter. [Borusan](https://www.borusan.com/en/news/presented-in-collaboration-with-borusan-holding-and-borusan-contemporary-the-edward-burtynsky-shifting-topography-special-selection-for-cop31-is-now-at-akra-antalya) · [Edward Burtynsky](https://www.edwardburtynsky.com/events/2026/11/9/edward-burtynsky-shifting-topography)

In an earlier interview published by the exhibition organisation, Burtynsky described using visual attraction to invite viewers to form their own view of changes to the land. A photography-magazine interview records his shift toward large-scale human impacts in the 1980s. These explain the artist’s approach; they do not establish a policy outcome. [Borusan Contemporary](https://blog.borusancontemporary.com/en/blog-conversation-with-edward-burtynsky-photography-landscape-human-impact_2469) · [Amateur Photographer](https://amateurphotographer.com/technique/interviews/edward-burtynsky-an-incredible-insight-into-abstraction-extraction/)

The beauty raises a question too. Reviewing a London exhibition in 2024, Helen Gordon described the gap between seeing an abstract composition and learning its industrial subject. Burtynsky has addressed the question of aestheticising destruction in a Guardian interview. A 2025 Art Newspaper report observed works from different periods at a New York retrospective. These are distinct readings of earlier presentations, not accounts of a visit to Antalya. [Apollo](https://apollo-magazine.com/edward-burtynsky-photographs-environment-saatchi-gallery-review/) · [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/2025/jun/26/edward-burtynsky-photographs-exhibition) · [The Art Newspaper](https://www.theartnewspaper.com/2025/06/19/edward-burtynsky-great-acceleration-international-center-photography)

For Burtynsky, framing is not a mechanical copy of what is in front of the camera. In an earlier PBS interview, he described waiting for light, attending to texture and season, and isolating one part of an expansive quarry: such choices give an ordinary industrial landscape another visual form. When ABC covered a public Sydney presentation of *In the Wake of Progress* in 2022, it also recorded his wish to draw attention to resource consumption and environmental change. [PBS interview transcript](https://www.pbs.org/video/edward-burtynsky-iznoyj/); [ABC Sydney report](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-09-02/edward-burtynsky-environment-photography-climate-change/101394660).

stories.title: Larry Reed 的皮影、舞台与电影
stories.titleEn: Larry Reed’s shadows reach cinematic scale
stories.zhDeck: 康涅狄格大学的巴拉德木偶艺术研究所与博物馆于 11 月 6 日开启“Larry Reed: Cinematic Shadows”。
stories.enDeck: “Larry Reed: Cinematic Shadows” opened on November 6 at the Ballard Institute and Museum of Puppetry at the University of Connecticut.
stories.zhMarkdown:
康涅狄格大学的巴拉德木偶艺术研究所与博物馆于 11 月 6 日开启“Larry Reed: Cinematic Shadows”。展览把剪影戏、电影与现场表演放在同一个观看空间：展出创作材料，涉及《The Wild Party》和《A (Balinese) Tempest》，并设置可互动的三维影子面具。影子在这里不仅是成品，也是可以通过身体和光线重新理解的过程。[ShadowLight 公布的开幕介绍](https://www.shadowlight.org/events/the-ballard-institute-celebrates-the-opening-of-larry-reed-cinematic-shadows-with-a-free-tour-and-forum)；[校园媒体的现场报道](https://dailycampus.com/2026/11/09/larry-reeds-legacy-lives-through-display-at-ballard/)。

Reed 的影戏语言离不开巴厘岛 wayang 传统，但不能把它简化成一位美国艺术家的独自发明。史密森尼的研究资料记录了他与巴厘艺术家 I Wayan Wija、I Made Sidia 等人的跨文化合作；纽约大学的档案也保存了 Wija 与当地工匠参与《MahabharANTa》的线索。这些历史资料呈现了合作中不同创作者的角色。[史密森尼亚洲艺术研究](https://asia.si.edu/research/essays/gold/)；[纽约大学档案](https://findingaids.library.nyu.edu/fales/mss_133/all/)。

早年的采访显示，Reed 关心的不只是复制传统轮廓，更是屏幕、灯光、表演者与观众之间的距离如何改变叙事。他曾回忆一次停电后改用蜡烛和手电的经历：技术故障反而让光源的选择重新变得可见。[The Nation 的采访](https://www.nationthailand.com/life/30302288)；[Mission Local 的人物报道](https://missionlocal.org/2023/08/people-we-meet-larry-reed-shadow-artist/)。

传统形式里，操偶者不仅移动影偶，也要组织人物声音和音乐。KQED 早年介绍 Reed 与 Gamelan Sekar Jaya 的合作时，描述了 dalang 与乐队之间的呼应；另一篇关于 2017 年《In Visible Light》的报道则点名音乐家 I Dewa Putu Berata、舞者 Emiko Saraswati Susilo 与 Reed 的合作。把合作者放回叙述中，才能看见这种舞台语言的共同创作；[KQED Spark](https://ww2.kqed.org/spark/larry-reed/)；[KQED 艺术节报道](https://www.kqed.org/arts/13331820/asian-artists-front-and-center-at-sf-international-arts-festival)。

旧金山亚洲艺术博物馆此前的活动介绍还解释过另一种尺度：影偶、真人、剪影和多个光源在大幕上共同构成连续的画面。博物馆当时还计划让观众近距离接触道具。[亚洲艺术博物馆活动资料](https://calendar.asianart.org/event/shadowlight-50-years-of-shadow-theater/)。

这场展览值得看的，是它把通常藏在幕后的转换摊开：纸偶、身体、灯具和屏幕一起制造影像。把幕后材料与互动装置并置，也让观众有机会理解，所谓“电影感”并非只来自镜头，同样来自舞台上对尺度和运动的组织。[2007 年 Reed 采访](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/feat/archives/2007/03/16/2003352604)。
stories.enMarkdown:
“Larry Reed: Cinematic Shadows” opened on November 6 at the Ballard Institute and Museum of Puppetry at the University of Connecticut. Its materials bring shadow theatre, cinema and live performance into the same space, including material connected to *The Wild Party* and *A (Balinese) Tempest* and an interactive three-dimensional shadow-mask component. Shadow becomes both an image and a process that visitors can approach through bodies and light. [ShadowLight’s opening information](https://www.shadowlight.org/events/the-ballard-institute-celebrates-the-opening-of-larry-reed-cinematic-shadows-with-a-free-tour-and-forum); [the campus newspaper’s report](https://dailycampus.com/2026/11/09/larry-reeds-legacy-lives-through-display-at-ballard/).

Reed’s work is deeply connected to Balinese wayang, but it should not be framed as the solitary invention of an American artist. Smithsonian research documents cross-cultural collaborations with Balinese artists including I Wayan Wija and I Made Sidia; New York University’s archive records Wija and local artisans’ involvement in *MahabharANTa*. These are historical sources on collaboration, not an inventory of the current exhibition. [Smithsonian research](https://asia.si.edu/research/essays/gold/); [NYU archive](https://findingaids.library.nyu.edu/fales/mss_133/all/).

Earlier interviews show Reed attending to the distance between screens, light, performers and spectators as much as to silhouettes themselves. He recalled a power cut that led performers to use candles and flashlights, making the choice of light source visible again. That is his account of an earlier event, not an eyewitness description of the present installation. [The Nation interview](https://www.nationthailand.com/life/30302288); [Mission Local profile](https://missionlocal.org/2023/08/people-we-meet-larry-reed-shadow-artist/).

In the traditional form, the puppeteer organizes voices and music as well as moving figures. An earlier KQED profile of Reed and Gamelan Sekar Jaya describes the exchange between dalang and musicians; a separate report on the 2017 *In Visible Light* identifies musician I Dewa Putu Berata, dancer Emiko Saraswati Susilo and Reed as collaborators. Naming the collaborators restores the collective work behind the stage language. [KQED Spark](https://ww2.kqed.org/spark/larry-reed/); [KQED festival report](https://www.kqed.org/arts/13331820/asian-artists-front-and-center-at-sf-international-arts-festival).

A previous Asian Art Museum program described another scale of performance, combining puppets, actors, cutouts and multiple light sources on a large screen. The museum also planned a close encounter with the props. [Asian Art Museum program](https://calendar.asianart.org/event/shadowlight-50-years-of-shadow-theater/).

The exhibition’s promise lies in opening up a transformation usually hidden backstage: puppets, bodies, lamps and a screen make an image together. Placing working materials alongside an interactive element also suggests that cinematic scale can come from the organization of movement on a stage, not only from a camera. [A 2007 Reed interview](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/feat/archives/2007/03/16/2003352604).

stories.title: 北九州成人式衣装：传统与反叛如何共存
stories.titleEn: Kitakyushu’s coming-of-age style comes to London
stories.zhDeck: 11 月 11 日起，伦敦 Japan House 的展览 《Tradition/Rebellion: Coming of Age Style in Kitakyushu》将通过八位年轻人的服装与个人故事，介绍日本北九州成人礼的视觉文化。
stories.enDeck: Opening November 11 at Japan House London, Tradition/Rebellion: Coming of Age Style in Kitakyushu uses eight young people's outfits and personal stories to introduce the visual culture of the Japanese city's coming-of-age celebrations. The exhibition runs until April 18, 2027. Embroidery, flags and elaborate styling are striking, but the exhibition also makes room for the people wearing them to speak.
stories.zhMarkdown:
11 月 11 日起，伦敦 Japan House 的展览 [《Tradition/Rebellion: Coming of Age Style in Kitakyushu》](https://www.japanhouselondon.uk/whats-on/traditionrebellion-coming-of-age-style-in-kitakyushu-japan/)将通过八位年轻人的服装与个人故事，介绍日本北九州成人礼的视觉文化。展期持续至 2027 年 4 月 18 日。抢眼的刺绣、旗帜和造型固然容易吸引视线，但展览也试图让穿衣服的人开口。

[共同社关于预展的报道](https://kumanichi.com/articles/2056051)提到，现场展示龙纹、旗帜等细节，并安排了八人的影像访谈。这八个故事让成人礼从一张热闹的新闻照片变成更具体的个人选择：衣服由谁制作，怎样与朋友约定，又如何在传统和自我表达之间找到位置。

日本家政学者太田茜对 2022 年和 2024 年北九州成人礼的[研究](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/kaseigakuinkiyo/65/0/65_51/_pdf/-char/en)提示，公共传播中醒目的男性装束只是全貌的一部分；女性穿着传统振袖的情况也很常见。Japan House 的[背景文章](https://www.japanhouselondon.uk/read-and-watch/japans-coming-of-age-day-and-why-kitakyushu-stands-out/)则梳理了成人日和北九州风格的文化背景。

衣装背后还有制作和协商的工作。[《HAIR MODE》对租衣店主池田雅的采访](https://hairmode.jp/hairbeauty/mm307541/)记录，一些客人会提前一年以上讨论造型；遇到动物头部或翅膀等造型需求，店家会手工制作，或寻求特效行业协助。她说，部分年轻顾客希望造型大胆，同时仍保留和服的形式。这是店主对自己顾客的观察。

年轻人对媒体焦点也有自己的回应。在 [2024 年《文春》的现场采访](https://bunshun.jp/articles/-/68236)中，一位选择袴装的女性说，她从短视频看到女性穿袴，也希望改变成人礼报道中男性更受关注的印象。这是一位参与者当年的表达，并不代表所有女性。

对媒体如何呈现成人礼，北九州的讨论也有更长的历史。[市政府 2016 年调查](https://www.city.kitakyushu.lg.jp/files/000755193.pdf)收到 678 份回复，回收率为 22.6%；自由意见中，有人担心报道只聚焦少数醒目的服装，也有人认为只要不妨碍仪式就应尊重穿着自由。这些不同的声音，来自十年前参与调查的部分市民。

今年的日本现场报道也呈现不同人的动机与准备过程：[文春](https://bunshun.jp/articles/-/85253)、[集英社在线](https://shueisha.online/articles/-/256213)和 [RKB](https://newsdig.tbs.co.jp/articles/rkb/2395718?page=3)采访的年轻人经历并不相同。市政府的[活动说明](https://www.city.kitakyushu.lg.jp/contents/11901279_00002.html)还记录了年轻组织者的参与。与其把夸张造型当成一个城市的标签，不如把它当作入口：看看不同的人如何决定自己成年的样子。
stories.enMarkdown:
Opening November 11 at Japan House London, [*Tradition/Rebellion: Coming of Age Style in Kitakyushu*](https://www.japanhouselondon.uk/whats-on/traditionrebellion-coming-of-age-style-in-kitakyushu-japan/) uses eight young people's outfits and personal stories to introduce the visual culture of the Japanese city's coming-of-age celebrations. The exhibition runs until April 18, 2027. Embroidery, flags and elaborate styling are striking, but the exhibition also makes room for the people wearing them to speak.

A [Kyodo report from the preview](https://kumanichi.com/articles/2056051) describes dragon motifs, flags and eight video interviews. These accounts cannot represent a whole city. They do, however, turn a spectacular news image into a set of personal choices: who makes the clothing, how friends plan together and where tradition meets self-expression.

Researcher Akane Ota's [study of the 2022 and 2024 celebrations](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/kaseigakuinkiyo/65/0/65_51/_pdf/-char/en) shows that the highly visible male styles are only part of the picture; traditional furisode are also common among women. A [Japan House background essay](https://www.japanhouselondon.uk/read-and-watch/japans-coming-of-age-day-and-why-kitakyushu-stands-out/) traces the wider history of Coming of Age Day and the city's style.

The clothes also involve negotiation and making. In a [HAIR MODE interview](https://hairmode.jp/hairbeauty/mm307541/), costume-rental shop owner Miyabi Ikeda said some customers discuss their ideas more than a year in advance. For animal heads or wings, the shop makes elements by hand or asks special-effects specialists for help. She observed that some customers want bold looks while retaining a connection to kimono. Her account describes her own clientele.

Young people have their own responses to the media spotlight. In a [2024 Bunshun interview at the ceremony](https://bunshun.jp/articles/-/68236), a woman who chose hakama said she had seen women wearing them in short videos and wanted to challenge the attention typically given to men’s looks. Hers is one participant’s account, not a view attributable to every woman.

Kitakyushu has discussed how the ceremony is represented in the media for years. A [2016 city survey](https://www.city.kitakyushu.lg.jp/files/000755193.pdf) received 678 responses, a 22.6% response rate. In written comments, some respondents worried that coverage focused on a small number of conspicuous outfits; others supported freedom of dress as long as the ceremony was not disrupted. These were views of some respondents at the time, not a measure of the whole city today.

Reports from this year's celebrations by [Bunshun](https://bunshun.jp/articles/-/85253), [Shueisha Online](https://shueisha.online/articles/-/256213) and [RKB](https://newsdig.tbs.co.jp/articles/rkb/2395718?page=3) show different motivations and preparations. The [city's own account](https://www.city.kitakyushu.lg.jp/contents/11901279_00002.html) records young people's role in organising the event. Rather than turning an extravagant look into a label for a city, the exhibition offers a way to ask how different people choose to mark adulthood.

stories.title: ISSEY MIYAKE 把旅途风景印进扭转薄纱
stories.titleEn: ISSEY MIYAKE folds landscapes into twisted chiffon
stories.zhDeck: ISSEY MIYAKE 的 CHIFFON TWIST VIEW POINT 把自然风景印在经过褶皱与扭转处理的轻薄面料上：当衣服穿在身体上，图案不会只停留在平面的照片效果，而是随着面料的起伏被重新组织。
stories.enDeck: ISSEY MIYAKE's CHIFFON TWIST VIEW POINT places imagery of natural scenery on lightweight fabric treated with pleating and twisting.
stories.zhMarkdown:
ISSEY MIYAKE 的 CHIFFON TWIST VIEW POINT 把自然风景印在经过褶皱与扭转处理的轻薄面料上：当衣服穿在身体上，图案不会只停留在平面的照片效果，而是随着面料的起伏被重新组织。日本品牌公告称，系列计划 11 月 15 日起在日本发售；[美国站](https://us.isseymiyake.com/blogs/news/18891)另列当地销售资讯，不能把日本时间当成全球时间。[ISSEY MIYAKE 日本](https://www.isseymiyake.com/en/blogs/news/18891)

风景印花与衣服的结构在这里同时工作。图像提供辨认的线索，褶皱则让同一幅图像在衣架上与身体上呈现不同的节奏。面料的变化也让图案随穿着方式出现不同表情。[日本品牌介绍](https://www.isseymiyake.com/en/blogs/news/18891) · [Fashion Press](https://www.fashion-press.net/news/153023)

品牌 2024 年关于 CHIFFON TWIST 的旧展览资料已经讨论过薄纱的褶与扭转；而 2016 年东京国立新美术馆的三宅一生展将服装与身体的运动放在更长的设计脉络里看。这些旧资料勾勒出品牌持续研究的方向。[ISSEY MIYAKE 旧展](https://eu.isseymiyake.com/blogs/shikaku/17617) · [国立新美术馆](https://www.nact.jp/english/exhibition_special/2016/miyake_issey/)

褶皱曾被三宅一生用来重新思考衣服如何从平面变成立体。费城艺术博物馆在一件 1989 年历史藏品的说明中，介绍了先裁缝较大衣形、再用热与压力定褶的过程；ASU FIDM Museum 则记录过更早一条丝绸裤子如何依靠缝合形成褶皱。两件旧作使用不同方式处理布料，也让“褶”显出不止一种技术路径。MoMA 对设计师的介绍进一步把这种探索放到身体与布料之间的空间、活动自由和日常实用性中理解。[费城艺术博物馆](https://www.philamuseum.org/objects/87123)；[ASU FIDM Museum](https://thefidmmuseum.org/learn/articles/issey-miyakes-early-pleats)；[MoMA](https://www.moma.org/artists/21439-issey-miyake)。

与新系列同时，品牌计划在新宿 SHIKAKU 举办《CHIFFON TWIST: Emerging Presence》，时间为 11 月 15 日至 2027 年 1 月 4 日。展览与日本发售同日开启，让面料的形态多了一个现场观看的入口。[品牌展览公告](https://www.isseymiyake.com/blogs/shikaku/18882)。

另一个值得看的切口是材料开发本身。[PLAT 的访谈](https://npo-plat.org/miyake-issey-en.html)记录了与三宅设计项目有关的工作人员如何讨论样布、染色和肌理；大都会艺术博物馆收藏的[历史作品](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/83329)则提供了对照。两者为理解材料开发提供了不同的历史视角。
stories.enMarkdown:
ISSEY MIYAKE's CHIFFON TWIST VIEW POINT places imagery of natural scenery on lightweight fabric treated with pleating and twisting. On the body, the image is reorganized by the movement and contours of the material. The Japanese announcement gives a planned November 15 launch in Japan; the [US page](https://us.isseymiyake.com/blogs/news/18891) lists its own market information. [ISSEY MIYAKE Japan](https://www.isseymiyake.com/en/blogs/news/18891)

The print and the garment's structure work together: the image offers something recognizable, while folds change its visual rhythm from hanger to wearer. The material can make the print look different as the garment is worn. [Brand announcement](https://www.isseymiyake.com/en/blogs/news/18891) · [Fashion Press](https://www.fashion-press.net/news/153023)

A [2024 brand exhibition](https://eu.isseymiyake.com/blogs/shikaku/17617) discussed CHIFFON TWIST and the relationship between pleats and twists; the National Art Center, Tokyo's [2016 Miyake exhibition](https://www.nact.jp/english/exhibition_special/2016/miyake_issey/) placed clothing and bodily movement in a longer history. Together they sketch a longer history of the brand’s experiments.

Pleating has long been a way for Miyake to rethink how a flat material becomes a three-dimensional garment. The Philadelphia Museum of Art describes a historical 1989 piece made by cutting and sewing an oversized form before heat and pressure set its pleats; ASU FIDM Museum documents an earlier pair of silk trousers whose folds were held by seams. The two examples show different ways of working with cloth. MoMA places the designer’s work in a wider interest in the space between body and fabric, freedom of movement and everyday use. [Philadelphia Museum of Art](https://www.philamuseum.org/objects/87123); [ASU FIDM Museum](https://thefidmmuseum.org/learn/articles/issey-miyakes-early-pleats); [MoMA](https://www.moma.org/artists/21439-issey-miyake).

Alongside the collection, the brand plans *CHIFFON TWIST: Emerging Presence* at SHIKAKU in Shinjuku from November 15 to January 4, 2027. It opens on the same day as the Japanese launch, offering another opportunity to encounter the fabric’s forms in person. [Brand exhibition announcement](https://www.isseymiyake.com/blogs/shikaku/18882).

[Interviews collected by PLAT](https://npo-plat.org/miyake-issey-en.html) offer another perspective on the development of sample textiles, dye and texture, while a [historic garment at the Met](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/83329) provides a separate archival reference. Each provides a distinct historical perspective on material development.

stories.title: Sister Wives 新歌与劳动价值的压力
stories.titleEn: Sister Wives turn the pressure to be useful into a song
stories.zhDeck: 谢菲尔德乐队 Sister Wives 公布新专辑《Heavy Set》将于 2027 年 2 月 5 日发行，共九首歌。
stories.enDeck: Sheffield band Sister Wives have announced Heavy Set, a nine-track album due on February 5, 2027.
stories.zhMarkdown:
谢菲尔德乐队 Sister Wives 公布新专辑《Heavy Set》将于 2027 年 2 月 5 日发行，共九首歌。乐队同时分享了单曲《Hairless Whisper》。[专辑页面](https://sisterwivesmusic.bandcamp.com/album/heavy-set)；[专辑公告报道](https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/news/sheffields-sister-wives-announce-new-album-heavy-set-with-laugh-cry-single-hairless-whisper)。

据 The Line of Best Fit 报道，成员 Rose Love 将歌曲的主题指向一种熟悉的衡量方式：当生产力变成个人价值的证明，人便很难允许自己停下来。这是乐队对歌曲主题的解释。[The Line of Best Fit](https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/news/sheffields-sister-wives-announce-new-album-heavy-set-with-laugh-cry-single-hairless-whisper)。

《Heavy Set》的名字也承载了乐队的另一层用意。Rose Love 说它最初来自一组偏重型的曲目；Rachael Loomes 则谈到，这个常被用来评价女性身体的词，也可以被重新拿回来使用。报道还提到，四位成员共同参与写歌、写词和演唱；Donna Lee 将新歌想象为在现实压力之外寻找另一种空间。这里呈现的是成员对新专辑的介绍，唱片还要等到明年才能完整听见。[The Line of Best Fit](https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/news/sheffields-sister-wives-announce-new-album-heavy-set-with-laugh-cry-single-hairless-whisper)；[LOUD WOMEN](https://loudwomen.org/2026/11/09/track-of-the-day-sister-wives-announce-new-album-heavy-set-with-hairless-whisper/)。

Sister Wives 在谢菲尔德活动，却也一直与威尔士语及其文化记忆保持联系。Donna Lee 早年谈到威尔士语是她的母语；此前单曲《YnCanu》则围绕威尔士 Cemaes 的故事、自然和核能相关场景展开。这些旧作让人看到乐队此前如何把地点与故事写进音乐。[2022 年采访](https://www.godisinthetvzine.co.uk/2022/02/04/welsh-language-music-day-2022-sister-wives/)；[《YnCanu》报道](https://circuitsweet.co.uk/2025/05/sister-wives-share-new-single-yncanu-out-now-via-libertino-records-single-feature/)。

乐队此前也通过《Malady》等作品，把个人感受放进更宽的社会处境里。对于《Hairless Whisper》，最值得留意的或许正是这个尺度：一首关于效率焦虑的歌，让个人价值如何被工作衡量成为可讨论的问题。[《Malady》首发报道](https://www.godisinthetvzine.co.uk/2025/02/18/exclusive-sister-wives-malady-single-premiere/)；[乐队早期访谈](https://nowthenmagazine.com/articles/sister-wives-fuzz-bass-and-witch-marks)。
stories.enMarkdown:
Sheffield band Sister Wives have announced *Heavy Set*, a nine-track album due on February 5, 2027. The band also shared the single “Hairless Whisper”. [Album page](https://sisterwivesmusic.bandcamp.com/album/heavy-set); [album announcement](https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/news/sheffields-sister-wives-announce-new-album-heavy-set-with-laugh-cry-single-hairless-whisper).

According to The Line of Best Fit, member Rose Love connects the song to a familiar measure of self-worth: when productivity becomes proof of value, it becomes difficult to permit oneself to stop. This is the band’s account of the song. [The Line of Best Fit](https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/news/sheffields-sister-wives-announce-new-album-heavy-set-with-laugh-cry-single-hairless-whisper).

The title *Heavy Set* carries another intention. Rose Love said it began with a set of heavier songs, while Rachael Loomes spoke about reclaiming a term often used disparagingly about women’s bodies. Reporting also says that all four members share songwriting, lyrics and vocals; Donna Lee describes the new songs as looking for an alternative space beyond present pressures. These are the members’ accounts of a record that listeners will be able to hear in full next year. [The Line of Best Fit](https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/news/sheffields-sister-wives-announce-new-album-heavy-set-with-laugh-cry-single-hairless-whisper); [LOUD WOMEN](https://loudwomen.org/2026/11/09/track-of-the-day-sister-wives-announce-new-album-heavy-set-with-hairless-whisper/).

Although based in Sheffield, Sister Wives have maintained ties to Welsh language and cultural memory. Donna Lee has described Welsh as her first language; their earlier single “YnCanu” drew on stories of Cemaes, nature and nuclear power. Those earlier songs provide context, not a complete description of the forthcoming album. [A 2022 interview](https://www.godisinthetvzine.co.uk/2022/02/04/welsh-language-music-day-2022-sister-wives/); [coverage of “YnCanu”](https://circuitsweet.co.uk/2025/05/sister-wives-share-new-single-yncanu-out-now-via-libertino-records-single-feature/).

Earlier work such as “Malady” also places personal feeling within a wider social setting. “Hairless Whisper” brings that focus to a question about how work comes to measure personal worth. [“Malady” premiere](https://www.godisinthetvzine.co.uk/2025/02/18/exclusive-sister-wives-malady-single-premiere/); [an earlier band interview](https://nowthenmagazine.com/articles/sister-wives-fuzz-bass-and-witch-marks).

stories.title: Beck 为《Disappearing Act》发布新影像
stories.titleEn: Beck’s “Disappearing Act” gets a new video
stories.zhDeck: Beck 于 11 月 9 日发布《Disappearing Act》的音乐录像。
stories.enDeck: Beck released a music video for “Disappearing Act” on November 9.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Beck 于 11 月 9 日发布《Disappearing Act》的音乐录像。报道将导演署名为 Mikai Karl，并称影片基于 Beck 的构想。歌曲本身于 8 月 19 日公开，随后收录进 9 月 18 日发行的专辑《Ride Lonesome》：这次更新的是视觉版本，而不是歌曲或专辑的首次发行。[MV 报道](https://www.udiscovermusic.com/news/beck-disappearing-act-video/)；[单曲首发报道](https://stereogum.com/2508741/beck-disappearing-act/music)。

《Ride Lonesome》延续了评论者常放在一起讨论的《Sea Change》和《Morning Phase》一线。《卫报》将新专辑放在这条关于失落与亲密关系的脉络里；这种“三部曲”说法是评论框架，不意味着每首歌都必须服从同一种故事。[The Guardian 专辑评论](https://www.theguardian.com/music/2026/sep/14/beck-ride-lonesome-review-stunning-end-to-the-heartache-trilogy-of-sea-change-and-morning-phase)。

在接受 Exclaim! 采访时，Beck 谈到唱片制作，以及 Nigel Godrich 担任混音等细节。NPR 的报道则把录制过程追溯到 2022 年，之后暂停并在 2024 至 2025 年间继续。这段漫长的制作过程，勾勒出专辑形成的背景。[Exclaim! 采访](https://exclaim.ca/music/article/beck-interview-ride-lonesome)；[NPR 报道](https://www.northcountrypublicradio.org/news/npr/nx-s1-5891950/beck-completes-heartache-trilogy-with-new-album-ride-lonesome)。

歌曲最初公开时，《Rolling Stone》的报道留意到它留白较多的歌词和弦乐，并把主题读作朝新的方向前进。唱片公司当时也明确区分了分工：Beck 是歌曲制作人，Nigel Godrich 负责混音。对于这张专辑，Beck 在日本音乐媒体 Mikiki 的采访中谈到自己长期保持在工作室创作、与不同音乐人合作的习惯。把这些制作和评论放回 8、9 月的时间线上，能更清楚地看见这首歌如何先成为专辑的一部分，再获得新的影像入口。[Rolling Stone](https://au.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/beck-new-single-disappearing-act-ride-lonesome-album-100026/)；[环球音乐 8 月公告](https://www.universalmusic.ca/2026/08/19/beck-ride-lonesome-new-album-out-september-18-disappearing-act-new-song-out-now/)；[Mikiki 采访](https://mikiki.tokyo.jp/articles/-/46138)。

将一首已经被听众认识的歌重新交给影像，是一次改变入口的机会：音乐可以先留下感受，视频再提出一套具体的观看方式。专辑在发行后已获得不同媒体的评论，也进入现场演出报道；具体镜头和视听体验仍需直接观看影片核验，这里不把转述写成亲历。[Double J 专辑评论](https://www.abc.net.au/listen/doublej/featured-music/feature-albums1/beck-ride-lonesome-feature-album-review/107167498)；[Boston.com 演出报道](https://www.boston.com/culture/concert-reviews/2026/10/19/review-setlist-beck-at-mgm-music-hall-oct-17-2026/)。
stories.enMarkdown:
Beck released a music video for “Disappearing Act” on November 9. Coverage credits Mikai Karl as director and says the film is based on an idea by Beck. The song appeared on August 19 and was included on *Ride Lonesome*, released September 18: the new item is the visual version, not the first release of the song or album. [Video report](https://www.udiscovermusic.com/news/beck-disappearing-act-video/); [single coverage](https://stereogum.com/2508741/beck-disappearing-act/music).

Critics have placed *Ride Lonesome* alongside *Sea Change* and *Morning Phase*. The Guardian reads the new record through that line of loss and intimate relationships; the idea of a “trilogy” is a critical frame, not a requirement that every track tell the same story. [The Guardian review](https://www.theguardian.com/music/2026/sep/14/beck-ride-lonesome-review-stunning-end-to-the-heartache-trilogy-of-sea-change-and-morning-phase).

In an Exclaim! interview, Beck discussed the record’s making, including Nigel Godrich’s role as mixer. NPR traces recording back to 2022, followed by a pause and further work in 2024–25. That longer production history helps explain the album’s formation; it does not establish the meaning of any particular shot or lyric. [Exclaim! interview](https://exclaim.ca/music/article/beck-interview-ride-lonesome); [NPR report](https://www.northcountrypublicradio.org/news/npr/nx-s1-5891950/beck-completes-heartache-trilogy-with-new-album-ride-lonesome).

When the song first appeared, *Rolling Stone* noted its sparse lyrics and string backing, reading it as a movement toward a new direction. The label distinguished the production roles: Beck produced the song and Nigel Godrich mixed it. In an interview with Japanese music publication Mikiki, Beck discussed his long-standing habit of working in the studio and collaborating with different musicians. That August–September timeline shows how the song first became part of the album before finding another entry point through video. [Rolling Stone](https://au.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/beck-new-single-disappearing-act-ride-lonesome-album-100026/); [Universal Music’s August announcement](https://www.universalmusic.ca/2026/08/19/beck-ride-lonesome-new-album-out-september-18-disappearing-act-new-song-out-now/); [Mikiki interview](https://mikiki.tokyo.jp/articles/-/46138).

Giving a familiar song a visual form creates another way in: music can first leave an impression, and a video can then propose a specific way of looking. The album has already drawn reviews and live coverage. Specific images and audiovisual effects still require direct viewing; a report should not be presented as a firsthand experience. [Double J review](https://www.abc.net.au/listen/doublej/featured-music/feature-albums1/beck-ride-lonesome-feature-album-review/107167498); [Boston.com concert report](https://www.boston.com/culture/concert-reviews/2026/10/19/review-setlist-beck-at-mgm-music-hall-oct-17-2026/).

stories.title: Vans × Pringle：菱格纹进入滑板鞋
stories.titleEn: Vans and Pringle bring argyle to skate shoes
stories.zhDeck: Vans 与 Pringle of Scotland 把苏格兰针织的菱格视觉带入鞋与服装系列。
stories.enDeck: Vans and Pringle of Scotland bring the visual language of Scottish argyle into a footwear and apparel collection.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Vans 与 Pringle of Scotland 把苏格兰针织的菱格视觉带入鞋与服装系列。它的趣味在于两个日常符号的相遇：Vans 的帆布鞋轮廓足够熟悉，菱格则让表面突然有了毛衣与学院服饰的联想。日本站已列出联名商品；具体款式和购买状态应以各地区产品页为准。[Vans 日本](https://www.vans.co.jp/collections/vans-x-pringle-of-scotland/) · [Sole Retriever](https://www.soleretriever.com/news/articles/pringle-of-scotland-vans-collection-release-date-november-2026)

系列并不是所有鞋都使用同一种材料。例如，[美国官网列出的 Premium Authentic](https://www.vans.com/en-us/p/shoes/icons/authentic-5310/vans-x-pringle-of-scotland-premium-authentic-shoe-VN000EK4BPR)具体使用拉绒羊毛与菱格图案；这是该鞋款的具体材料说明。

[V&A Dundee 的品牌历史](https://www.vam.ac.uk/dundee/articles/scottish-design-icons-pringle)让人看到 Pringle 与苏格兰针织设计之间的长期关系。[皇家艺术学院收藏的设计研究](https://researchonline.rca.ac.uk/1447/87/future%20fashion%20now%20v%26a%20online%20journal%20Deirdre%20Murphy.pdf)则讨论品牌如何重新处理自己的经典视觉。菱格在这里不是一句怀旧标签，它是一套可以反复改变比例、颜色和载体的图形语言。

合作并非只把一个图案放在单一鞋型上。品牌新闻稿列出 Authentic 44、Sk8-Hi Reissue 38 和 Classic Slip-On 98 三种轮廓，并延伸到毛衣、背心、帽子与袜子；球鞋媒体 Sneakerjagers 还记录了黑白与海军蓝等配色，以及服装上棋盘格与菱格的组合。轮廓保持可辨认，图案和配色则在鞋与服装之间切换；各款材料仍以对应商品页为准。[品牌新闻稿](https://shop-eat-surf-outdoor.com/press-releases/vans-partners-with-pringle-of-scotland/624500/)；[Sneakerjagers](https://www.sneakerjagers.com/en/n/vans-x-pringle-of-scotland-argyle-skate-classics/8172)。

回到 Pringle 的历史，苏格兰国家博物馆 2015 年的《Fully Fashioned》通过衣物、档案和影像，追溯它从 Hawick 的针织袜业走向国际针织品牌的过程。那段历史提供了菱格的文化背景，而这次合作让它进入了另一种更日常的鞋履轮廓。[苏格兰国家博物馆](https://www.nms.ac.uk/past-exhibitions/fully-fashioned)。

菱格在 Pringle 自己的档案中也并非一成不变。i-D 报道其 2019 春夏系列时，留意到设计师把旧有的花卉针织与菱格叠在一起，让熟悉的几何图案遇到新的色彩和纹理。这次 Vans 合作则把图案带向鞋履和服装，两次转换各自使用不同的载体。[i-D 2018 年报道](https://i-d.co/article/pringle-of-scotland-spring-summer-19/)。

这套语言也有生产史的一面。评论人 Anna Battista 在[2015 年展评](https://www.irenebrination.com/2015/04/27/pringle-of-scotland-nms/)中既关注品牌的针织创新，也批评展览对本地制造讨论不足；[2019 年的设计师采访](https://www.vogue.co.uk/fashion/article/pringle-of-scotland-reissued1-collection-london-fashion-week)展示了旧档案如何被重新解释。这两篇资料从不同角度讨论了品牌的历史与设计。
stories.enMarkdown:
Vans and Pringle of Scotland bring the visual language of Scottish argyle into a footwear and apparel collection. The appeal lies in the meeting of familiar everyday codes: a Vans silhouette reads immediately as a skate shoe, while the pattern brings knitwear and collegiate dress to mind. The [Japanese collection page](https://www.vans.co.jp/collections/vans-x-pringle-of-scotland/) lists the products; check individual regional pages for availability. [Sole Retriever](https://www.soleretriever.com/news/articles/pringle-of-scotland-vans-collection-release-date-november-2026)

Materials differ across the collection. One [US Premium Authentic listing](https://www.vans.com/en-us/p/shoes/icons/authentic-5310/vans-x-pringle-of-scotland-premium-authentic-shoe-VN000EK4BPR) specifies brushed wool and an argyle pattern. That is the material listed for this particular shoe.

[V&A Dundee's history](https://www.vam.ac.uk/dundee/articles/scottish-design-icons-pringle) traces Pringle's longstanding place in Scottish knitwear. A [design study held by the Royal College of Art](https://researchonline.rca.ac.uk/1447/87/future%20fashion%20now%20v%26a%20online%20journal%20Deirdre%20Murphy.pdf) considers the brand's reworking of its established codes. Argyle can travel between different scales, colours and objects while remaining recognizable.

The collaboration applies its pattern across more than one silhouette. The brand’s release names the Authentic 44, Sk8-Hi Reissue 38 and Classic Slip-On 98, alongside sweaters, vests, hats and socks. Sneaker publication Sneakerjagers also describes black-and-white and navy colourways and the combination of checkerboard and argyle on apparel. The recognizable silhouettes remain, while pattern and colour move between shoes and clothes; materials should be checked on each product page. [Brand release](https://shop-eat-surf-outdoor.com/press-releases/vans-partners-with-pringle-of-scotland/624500/); [Sneakerjagers](https://www.sneakerjagers.com/en/n/vans-x-pringle-of-scotland-argyle-skate-classics/8172).

For historical context, the National Museum of Scotland’s 2015 *Fully Fashioned* exhibition used garments, archives and film to trace Pringle from a Hawick hosiery firm to an international knitwear brand. That history gives the argyle a context; the collaboration carries it onto another familiar everyday form. [National Museums Scotland](https://www.nms.ac.uk/past-exhibitions/fully-fashioned).

Argyle has not stood still within Pringle’s own archive. Reporting on its spring/summer 2019 collection, i-D noted that the label overlaid the familiar diamonds with floral motifs, bringing a new play of colour and texture to the pattern. The Vans collaboration moves the motif onto shoes and apparel, using another set of everyday forms. [i-D, 2018](https://i-d.co/article/pringle-of-scotland-spring-summer-19/).

Production history matters too. In a [2015 exhibition review](https://www.irenebrination.com/2015/04/27/pringle-of-scotland-nms/), critic Anna Battista discussed innovation in knitwear while questioning the exhibition's treatment of local manufacturing. A [2019 designer interview](https://www.vogue.co.uk/fashion/article/pringle-of-scotland-reissued1-collection-london-fashion-week) shows another approach to revisiting the archive. They approach the brand’s history and design from different angles.

stories.title: INVINCIBLE × adidas：正装细节和运动衣鞋
stories.titleEn: INVINCIBLE and adidas bring tailoring into sportswear
stories.zhDeck: INVINCIBLE 与 adidas Consortium 的 Form in Motion 把正装剪裁带进运动服装，并推出一款以皮鞋语言重写 Samba 的鞋。
stories.enDeck: INVINCIBLE and adidas Consortium's Form in Motion brings tailoring into sportswear and reworks the Samba with dress-shoe references.
stories.zhMarkdown:
INVINCIBLE 与 adidas Consortium 的 Form in Motion 把正装剪裁带进运动服装，并推出一款以皮鞋语言重写 Samba 的鞋。合作方称，这是双方首次共同推出服装系列；亚洲市场从 11 月 7 日起发售，指定全球渠道 11 月 13 日跟进，其中 Dress Shoe Samba 为亚洲限定。[INVINCIBLE 官方](https://global.invincible.com.tw/pages/story-invincible%C2%AE-adidas-samba)

这双鞋值得看的是比例和场合的转换。Samba 原有的低帮轮廓与鞋头线条仍可辨认，偏正装的细节则把它从球鞋语境推向更正式的穿搭。服装系列同样尝试把运动与裁缝元素放在一处，品牌将其称作运动中的形式，而不是宣布一种全新的着装规则。[INVINCIBLE 印尼](https://www.invincible.id/blogs/launches-1/invincible%C2%AE-x-adidas-consortium-form-in-motion) · [Hypebeast](https://hypebeast.com/2026/11/invincible-adidas-consortium-form-in-motion-release-info) · [ST Magazine](https://www.stmagazine.net/en/invincible-adidas-consortium-samba-dress-shoes-2026)

理解这次改写，也可以先看 [adidas 的 Samba 档案](https://www.adidas.com/us/go/campaign/originals/archive/samba)：鞋型进入不同日常场景已有长时间积累。把它做得更像皮鞋，依然是对现有轮廓的重新编排，而不是创造一双没有来历的新鞋。

INVINCIBLE 主理人 Jimmy 的[2019 年采访](https://www.heavenraven.com/2019/05/18/streetwear-sneaker-select-shop-invincible-jimmy-interview/)谈到台湾、里原宿以及赴美时的球鞋经验；[另一篇访谈](https://urbansyndicate.co.uk/an-interview-with-jimmy-wu-the-vision-behind-invincible/)讨论他对合作关系与品牌契合的看法。这些是理解店铺视角的背景，并非他对 2026 这双 Samba 的设计动机说明。
stories.enMarkdown:
INVINCIBLE and adidas Consortium's Form in Motion brings tailoring into sportswear and reworks the Samba with dress-shoe references. The partners describe this as their first apparel collection together. The Asian release began November 7, selected global channels follow on November 13, and the Dress Shoe Samba is an Asia exclusive. [INVINCIBLE](https://global.invincible.com.tw/pages/story-invincible%C2%AE-adidas-samba)

The interesting shift is one of proportion and occasion. The low-cut Samba outline and toe remain recognizable, while more formal details suggest a different wardrobe around the shoe. The apparel similarly combines sportswear with tailoring; it is a proposal about how those languages can meet, not a new universal rule for dressing. [INVINCIBLE Indonesia](https://www.invincible.id/blogs/launches-1/invincible%C2%AE-x-adidas-consortium-form-in-motion) · [Hypebeast](https://hypebeast.com/2026/11/invincible-adidas-consortium-form-in-motion-release-info) · [ST Magazine](https://www.stmagazine.net/en/invincible-adidas-consortium-samba-dress-shoes-2026)

The [adidas Samba archive](https://www.adidas.com/us/go/campaign/originals/archive/samba) offers context for a silhouette that has accumulated meanings across different everyday settings. Turning it toward dress shoes rearranges those existing cues rather than creating a shoe without a past.

A [2019 interview](https://www.heavenraven.com/2019/05/18/streetwear-sneaker-select-shop-invincible-jimmy-interview/) with INVINCIBLE's Jimmy covers Taiwan, Ura-Harajuku and his sneaker experiences in the US; [another conversation](https://urbansyndicate.co.uk/an-interview-with-jimmy-wu-the-vision-behind-invincible/) discusses collaboration and fit between partners. They explain the shop's broader perspective, not the specific motivation behind this 2026 Samba.

stories.zhDeck: Story mfg. 与 ASICS 再次合作，将 GEL-TRANSCEND FJ 放进有关旅行与日常劳动的叙事中。
stories.enDeck: Story mfg. and ASICS return with a GEL-TRANSCEND FJ framed around travel and everyday work.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Story mfg. 与 ASICS 再次合作，将 GEL-TRANSCEND FJ 放进有关旅行与日常劳动的叙事中。报道将鞋面视觉与旅行毯联系起来，活动则围绕不同职业和身体经验展开。伦敦活动安排在 11 月 7–8 日，纽约活动为 11 月 10 日；后续线上及零售渠道时间各有不同，不能简单写成全球同一天发售。[Sneaker Freaker](https://www.sneakerfreaker.com/releases/story-mfg-x-asics-gel-transcend-fj-price-buy-release-date) · [The Sole Supplier](https://thesolesupplier.co.uk/news/asics-story-mfg-collaboration-gel-transcend-fj/)

这次合作有意思的地方，是它让功能运动鞋和手工织物的视觉相遇。运动鞋负责提供熟悉的结构，毯子的图案联想则让人想到携带、停留和路途。这样的读法来自设计呈现，不代表鞋子实际由手工编织，也不能仅凭联名叙事判断它的环境影响。[Sneaker Freaker](https://www.sneakerfreaker.com/releases/story-mfg-x-asics-gel-transcend-fj-price-buy-release-date) · [atmos 商品活动页](https://www.atmos-tokyo.com/raffles/9sqrgivu)

Story mfg. 的旧采访提供了为什么这种视觉会出现在这里的线索。两位创办人在[2020 年 i-D 采访](https://i-d.co/article/story-mfg-interterview-about-slow-sustainable-vegan-fashion-and-artisan-crafts/)中谈到钩针毯与服装设计，也谈到与工艺合作社的关系；[2021 年 Atmos 采访](https://atmos.earth/fashion-and-design/story-mfg-sustainable-fashion-interview/)记录了他们对染色和生产的看法。这些是品牌关于过去工作的自述，并非本次鞋款的供应链认证。

品牌在[2026 年 2 月文章](https://www.storymfg.com/blogs/essays/f)中谈过与 ASICS 的持续合作；[Vogue 的 2024 年采访](https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/story-mfg-interview)及 [END. 2026 年工作室采访](https://www.endclothing.com/en-us/blogs/features/work-is-love-made-visible-with-story-mfg)展示了另一些项目如何处理材料。读这些背景时应保留时间和项目区别：旧款材料与做法不能自动套用到 GEL-TRANSCEND FJ。
stories.enMarkdown:
Story mfg. and ASICS return with a GEL-TRANSCEND FJ framed around travel and everyday work. Coverage connects the shoe's visual language to a travel blanket and describes events built around different occupations and bodily experiences. London events were scheduled for November 7–8 and New York for November 10, with later online and retail releases varying by channel. [Sneaker Freaker](https://www.sneakerfreaker.com/releases/story-mfg-x-asics-gel-transcend-fj-price-buy-release-date) · [The Sole Supplier](https://thesolesupplier.co.uk/news/asics-story-mfg-collaboration-gel-transcend-fj/)

The collaboration puts the visual associations of a handmade textile next to the recognizable structure of a performance shoe. The blanket reference evokes carrying, stopping and moving through a journey. That is a reading of its presentation, not evidence that the shoe is hand-crocheted or that its environmental impact has been independently measured. [Sneaker Freaker](https://www.sneakerfreaker.com/releases/story-mfg-x-asics-gel-transcend-fj-price-buy-release-date) · [atmos product event](https://www.atmos-tokyo.com/raffles/9sqrgivu)

Earlier interviews offer context for that visual vocabulary. In [i-D in 2020](https://i-d.co/article/story-mfg-interterview-about-slow-sustainable-vegan-fashion-and-artisan-crafts/), the founders discussed crochet blankets, clothing and their work with a craft cooperative. A [2021 Atmos interview](https://atmos.earth/fashion-and-design/story-mfg-sustainable-fashion-interview/) recorded their views on dyeing and production. These are accounts of earlier work, not independent certification of this shoe's supply chain.

The brand discussed its ongoing ASICS relationship in a [February 2026 essay](https://www.storymfg.com/blogs/essays/f). A [2024 Vogue interview](https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/story-mfg-interview) and an [END. studio visit in 2026](https://www.endclothing.com/en-us/blogs/features/work-is-love-made-visible-with-story-mfg) show how other projects approached materials. Those earlier methods should not automatically be attributed to the GEL-TRANSCEND FJ.

stories.title: 涩谷 Streets and Voices：让街区照片重新发声
stories.titleEn: Shibuya’s streets and voices bring urban memory to life
stories.zhDeck: 从 11 月 10 日至 23 日，涩谷 Hikarie 的「街与声音」展览以 186 张照片和 12 位受访者的口述记录，重访城市的日常变化。
stories.enDeck: From November 10–23, an exhibition at Shibuya Hikarie revisits everyday urban change through 186 photographs and oral histories from 12 interviewees.
stories.zhMarkdown:
从 11 月 10 日至 23 日，涩谷 Hikarie 的「街与声音」展览以 186 张照片和 12 位受访者的口述记录，重访城市的日常变化。[涩谷区公告](https://www.city.shibuya.tokyo.jp/kusei/hodo/hodo-2026/hodo_20261104.html)与[主办方介绍](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000007.000151465.html)说，讲述者年龄横跨 40 多岁至 90 多岁。图像留住街面，人的声音则让街道有了时间。

[涩谷经济新闻](https://www.shibukei.com/headline/20266/)介绍，观众可以拿起电话听筒听取讲述，也能阅读日英文字。电话这个有些旧式的动作，让倾听变成一次更专注的私人经验。它不能替每个人说话，但可以提示我们：一座城市的历史不仅存在于大事件，也存在于店铺、道路和个人的日常路线里。

项目并非突然出现。有关组织者的[访谈](https://biz.shibuyabunka.com/event/1130/)和[项目报道](https://shibuya-shimbun.com/archives/15992)记录了搜集与展示的工作；[前一年的展览回顾](https://www.hikarie8.com/report/spae2025)提到，创办者从父亲留下的影像出发，对照招牌与地图理解街区。街区商会自己的[历史页面](https://hyakkendana.com/history/)则提供另一种以商业空间为中心的叙述。

这次展览把变化放到了可以辨认的地点。与场地有关联的[涩谷文化项目报道](https://biz.shibuyabunka.com/event/1130/)介绍，展出的一张 1958 年照片记录了稻荷桥餐饮街；今天相邻的涩谷川沿岸已是步道。照片旁的二维码还能连接到街景，让观众把旧影像与同一地点的现在并置。城市变化因此不再只是抽象的“过去与现在”，而是一处具体的街角。

照片档案看似客观，也有自己的边界：谁留下影像，谁被邀请讲述，都会影响最后的城市记忆。比起把旧涩谷当作更好的过去，这次展览更适合当作一次练习——在熟悉的地方，重新听听别人曾如何生活。
stories.enMarkdown:
From November 10–23, an exhibition at Shibuya Hikarie revisits everyday urban change through 186 photographs and oral histories from 12 interviewees. According to the [ward announcement](https://www.city.shibuya.tokyo.jp/kusei/hodo/hodo-2026/hodo_20261104.html) and [organiser](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000007.000151465.html), the speakers range from their forties to their nineties. Images preserve the street surface; voices give it time.

[Shibuya Keizai Shimbun](https://www.shibukei.com/headline/20266/) reports that visitors can pick up a telephone handset to listen, with Japanese and English text also available. The old-fashioned gesture makes listening a more focused, private experience. It cannot speak for everyone, but it suggests that urban history lives in shops, roads and daily routes as well as major events.

The project has a longer history. An [organiser interview](https://biz.shibuyabunka.com/event/1130/) and [local report](https://shibuya-shimbun.com/archives/15992) describe the work of collecting and presenting material. A [review of the previous exhibition](https://www.hikarie8.com/report/spae2025) recalls a founder using photographs left by his father, comparing signs and maps to understand the neighbourhood. A [shopping-street association's history](https://hyakkendana.com/history/) offers another account centred on commercial space.

The exhibition also locates change at recognisable sites. [Shibuya Culture Project](https://biz.shibuyabunka.com/event/1130/), a venue-affiliated publication, describes a 1958 photograph of the Inaribashi restaurant street; the nearby Shibuya River now has a pedestrian walkway. QR codes beside the images connect visitors to street views of the same locations. Change becomes less an abstract contrast between past and present than a question about a particular corner.

An archive of photographs has limits: who kept images, and who was invited to speak, shape the memory that survives. Rather than treating an older Shibuya as a better past, this show is an invitation to hear how other people once lived in a familiar place.

stories.title: Winiche&Co. × BEAMS JAPAN：棒球、虎纹与城市记忆
stories.titleEn: WINICHE and BEAMS JAPAN mix baseball, tigers and city memories
stories.zhDeck: WINICHE & CO. 与 BEAMS JAPAN 的新系列把纽约棒球、虎纹与街头服装放进同一套视觉里。
stories.enDeck: WINICHE & CO. and BEAMS JAPAN bring New York baseball, tiger imagery and streetwear into one collection.
stories.zhMarkdown:
WINICHE & CO. 与 BEAMS JAPAN 的新系列把纽约棒球、虎纹与街头服装放进同一套视觉里。BEAMS 公布的七款包括服装和配件，计划 11 月 13 日发售；它是一组服饰企划，没有公布联名鞋款。[BEAMS 官方](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5096/)

系列中蓝与橙让人联想到东京的棒球文化，也与纽约相关的视觉线索并置。官方将 Tiger Style 联系到 Wu-Tang Clan 的曲目和功夫电影文化，配件中还出现 New Era 的 59FIFTY。把这些元素放在一起，重点不只是复刻一个年代，而是展示棒球、嘻哈与日本街头服装如何在同一件日常物品上发生交会。[BEAMS](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5096/)

BEAMS 还提及 Spike Lee 和纽约洋基红色球帽的故事。[GQ 的 2019 年采访](https://www.gq-magazine.co.uk/fashion/article/spike-lee-interview-2019)记录了 Lee 对 1996 年红帽与红色飞行夹克的回忆；这是这次企划使用的文化背景，不代表 Lee 参与了 2026 年系列设计。

WINICHE 主理人 WIN 的[2021 年采访](https://sabukaru.online/articles/tokyo-streetwear-and-sneaker-og-meet-winiche)谈到纽约五区、迷彩与品牌名称，[GQ Japan 2020 年采访](https://www.gqjapan.jp/fashion/article/20201118-our-air-jordan-winiche)则连接他的篮球、Air Jordan 和嘻哈记忆。两者有助于理解他长期关心的东西，但不应被当成本次每个图案的直接设计说明。

WIN 的个人记忆也解释了这些文化线索如何在东京落地。他在 [2025 年为 POPEYE 写的文章](https://popeyemagazine.jp/post-242568/)里回忆，学生时代会到上野阿美横的球鞋店向店员打听资讯，也通过同学带来的 NBA 录像带认识篮球；后来，他在海外拍卖网站找到自己尺码的 Air Jordan 1。这些经历给系列中的城市与运动文化增添了一条更私人的时间线。

WIN 也把个人收藏变成可以走进去的空间。在 [Big Apple Scramble 的采访](https://www.bigapplescramble.com/places-winiche-jp)中，他说自己把办公室搬回东京下町后，因为租下的仓库有空余空间而开了选物店；他和朋友还动手制作了一座受纽约街头报刊亭启发的装置，让人可以走进去探索。选物的标准是自己觉得有用、喜欢或真正感兴趣，而非追逐潮流。这是他早年的空间实践，为理解其收藏与城市文化的关系提供了背景。

另一位来访者留下了这个空间的切身印象。[《MEN’S NON-NO》2022 年的探店](https://www.mensnonno.jp/fashion/new-topics/241472/)记录 PR01 PRESS 总监宫崎翔太逛 Winiche & Co. Warehouse：他提到店内同时陈列 WIN 的原创作品与各类小众商品，逛店像寻宝，也把购物视为拜访朋友的一种方式。报道拍下了他关注的袜子、挂绳和迷彩袋，提供了当年选物店如何被使用的一个视角。

这也不是品牌第一次进入 BEAMS 的场景：双方曾在[2019 年举办快闪](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/1506/)。WIN 也曾在[2023 年访谈](https://niewmedia.com/en/specials/grandmarquee26464/4/)中解释旧款袜子的设计思路；该说明属于当时产品，不足以推断新系列每个单品的材料或穿着效果。
stories.enMarkdown:
WINICHE & CO. and BEAMS JAPAN bring New York baseball, tiger imagery and streetwear into one collection. BEAMS lists seven clothing and accessory items for a planned November 13 release; the announcement does not list a collaborative shoe. [BEAMS](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5096/)

Blue and orange evoke Tokyo baseball culture alongside references associated with New York. The announcement connects Tiger Style with a Wu-Tang Clan track and kung fu film culture, while the accessories include a New Era 59FIFTY. The combination shows how baseball, hip-hop and Japanese streetwear can meet in familiar, wearable objects. [BEAMS](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5096/)

BEAMS also refers to the story of Spike Lee's red New York Yankees cap. In a [2019 GQ interview](https://www.gq-magazine.co.uk/fashion/article/spike-lee-interview-2019), Lee recalled the 1996 red cap and flight jacket. That is cultural background for the collection, not evidence that Lee designed it.

In a [2021 interview](https://sabukaru.online/articles/tokyo-streetwear-and-sneaker-og-meet-winiche), WINICHE founder WIN discussed New York's five boroughs, camouflage and the brand's name. A [2020 GQ Japan conversation](https://www.gqjapan.jp/fashion/article/20201118-our-air-jordan-winiche) connects his interests in basketball, Air Jordan and hip-hop. Both illuminate longer-standing interests; neither is a direct explanation of every 2026 graphic.

WIN’s own memories show how some of these cultural references reached Tokyo. In a [2025 essay for POPEYE](https://popeyemagazine.jp/post-242568/), he recalled asking staff at Ueno’s Ameyoko sneaker shops for information and discovering basketball through NBA videotapes brought by a classmate. Years later, he found an Air Jordan 1 in his size through an overseas auction site. The story gives the collection’s urban and sporting references a more personal timeline.

WIN also made his personal collection into a space people could enter. In an [interview with Big Apple Scramble](https://www.bigapplescramble.com/places-winiche-jp), he said he opened a select shop after moving his office to Tokyo’s downtown area and finding spare space in the warehouse. He and a friend also built a New York-inspired newsstand installation that visitors could walk inside. He chose objects for their usefulness and his own interests, rather than following trends. This earlier space gives context to the relationship between his collecting and urban culture.

A visitor’s account offers another view of that space. In a [2022 MEN’S NON-NO shop visit](https://www.mensnonno.jp/fashion/new-topics/241472/), PR01 PRESS director Shota Miyazaki described finding WIN’s original products alongside niche bootleg goods, likening the visit to a treasure hunt and shopping to seeing friends. The feature photographed the socks, strap and camouflage pouch that caught his attention, documenting one way the shop was experienced at the time.

The relationship with BEAMS has a history: there was a [2019 pop-up](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/1506/). WIN also explained an earlier sock design in a [2023 interview](https://niewmedia.com/en/specials/grandmarquee26464/4/); that account does not establish the materials or wear performance of each new item.

stories.title: 清川麻美与名和晃平：隐形花园
stories.titleEn: Invisible Garden extends its run in Tokyo
stories.zhDeck: 名和晃平与清川麻美的双人展《Invisible Garden》将延长至 12 月 27 日。
stories.enDeck: Invisible Garden, the two-person exhibition by Kohei Nawa and Asami Kiyokawa, has been extended through December 27.
stories.zhMarkdown:
名和晃平与清川麻美的双人展《Invisible Garden》将延长至 12 月 27 日。[艺术家公告](https://kohei-nawa.net/news/exhibition-invisible-garden/)与[展馆新闻资料](https://prtimes.jp/a/?c=69355&f=d69355-71-ee5449718c1b3d12ff833d41128c85b9.pdf&r=71)提供展期信息。延长展期为更多人提供了观看作品的机会。

[SCAI THE BATHHOUSE](https://www.scaithebathhouse.com/en/news/2026/09/kohei_nawa_pola_museum_annex/)介绍，现场的《PixCell-Our New World》长约九米。[美术手帖的现场报道](https://bijutsutecho.com/magazine/news/report/33070)讨论了自然图像、生成技术和透明球体在展览中的关系：球体改变了局部图像的尺度与视觉效果，让熟悉的自然不再像一张可以一眼看完的风景照。

两位艺术家的合作也有前史。2021 年[美术手帖采访](https://bijutsutecho.com/magazine/interview/oil/24972)谈到他们先前的《Metamorphosis Garden (full bloom)》，其中鹿的形象和刺绣已经构成不同媒介的交汇。名和晃平在 [ArtAsiaPacific 的旧访谈](https://www.artasiapacific.com/ideas/mind-and-matter-interview-with-kohei-nawa/)里谈过他对物质与感知的兴趣，这是他对早年创作的思考。

观看角度也构成作品的一部分。作家 Jonelle Patrick 在[个人观展记录](https://jonellepatrick.me/2026/10/02/invisible-garden-an-artist-collaboration-made-in-heaven/)中写到，《PixCell-Random》系列的透明球体在正面显出背后的颜色，走到侧面时又让颜色隐去。她把这种变化当作两位艺术家对视点的共同探索；这是一位观众的阅读，也为理解展览为什么需要身体移动提供了具体线索。

一篇[日本国际艺术评论家联盟的评论](https://critique.aicajapan.com/20454)提供了独立于展馆宣传的阅读路径；[现场报道](https://www.fashion-headline.com/ja/article/488032)则描述了展览的视觉组织。这个花园的吸引力也许正在于：它不要求自然保持原样，而让观看者留意技术、手工和记忆如何共同改变我们所见。
stories.enMarkdown:
*Invisible Garden*, the two-person exhibition by Kohei Nawa and Asami Kiyokawa, has been extended through December 27. The [artist's announcement](https://kohei-nawa.net/news/exhibition-invisible-garden/) and [venue release](https://prtimes.jp/a/?c=69355&f=d69355-71-ee5449718c1b3d12ff833d41128c85b9.pdf&r=71) provide the dates. An extension is not a new opening, but it gives people another opportunity to encounter the work.

[SCAI THE BATHHOUSE](https://www.scaithebathhouse.com/en/news/2026/09/kohei_nawa_pola_museum_annex/) identifies *PixCell-Our New World* as approximately nine metres long. A [Bijutsu Techo report](https://bijutsutecho.com/magazine/news/report/33070) discusses nature imagery, generative technology and transparent spheres: the spheres alter the scale and appearance of details, making the familiar landscape harder to take in at a glance.

The collaboration has a history. A [2021 Bijutsu Techo interview](https://bijutsutecho.com/magazine/interview/oil/24972) addressed their earlier *Metamorphosis Garden (full bloom)*, in which a deer image and embroidery already brought different media together. In an [older ArtAsiaPacific interview](https://www.artasiapacific.com/ideas/mind-and-matter-interview-with-kohei-nawa/), Nawa discussed material and perception; it is background, not a description of the process used in every current work.

The angle of viewing is part of the work. In her [personal exhibition account](https://jonellepatrick.me/2026/10/02/invisible-garden-an-artist-collaboration-made-in-heaven/), writer Jonelle Patrick describes the transparent spheres of the *PixCell-Random* series revealing colours from the front and letting them disappear from other angles. She reads that shift as a shared exploration of perspective. It is one visitor’s response, and a concrete clue to why movement through the exhibition matters.

A [review from AICA Japan](https://critique.aicajapan.com/20454) offers a reading independent of venue promotion, while [Fashion Headline](https://www.fashion-headline.com/ja/article/488032) describes the visual arrangement. The garden's appeal may lie in its refusal to keep nature fixed: it asks how technology, handwork and memory together change what we see.

stories.title: Diedrick Brackens：将黑人生活经验编进织物
stories.titleEn: Diedrick Brackens weaves histories into cloth
stories.zhDeck: 巴尔的摩艺术博物馆的《Diedrick Brackens: lights at the end of the world》于 11 月 8 日开幕，将展至 2027 年 2 月 28 日。
stories.enDeck: “Diedrick Brackens: lights at the end of the world” opened at the Baltimore Museum of Art on November 8 and runs through February 28, 2027.
stories.zhMarkdown:
巴尔的摩艺术博物馆的《Diedrick Brackens: lights at the end of the world》于 11 月 8 日开幕，将展至 2027 年 2 月 28 日。馆方介绍，新作与切萨皮克地区的历史叙事有关，光与马等意象进入作品。展览把纺织带进一个同时关心地方、记忆和未来的语境。[巴尔的摩艺术博物馆展览页](https://artbma.org/exhibition/diedrick-brackens-lights-at-the-end-of-the-world/)；[馆方新闻资料](https://artbma.org/press-release/bma-presents-new-work-by-acclaimed-artist-diedrick-brackens/)。

Brackens 使用纺织并非只因为它具有柔软的表面。在 Art21 的工作室对话中，他谈及棉花与劳动史的关系：材料本身带着历史，制作也需要时间。把这一背景带进展厅，可以帮助理解作品如何通过日常材料承载更复杂的叙事，但不应把每一件新作都压成同一条寓意。[Art21 工作室对话](https://art21.org/read/in-the-studio-diedrick-brackens/)。

他此前多次谈到编织的身体性、信仰与图像之间的关系；2025 年《卫报》的访谈也记录了他如何以织物讲述故事。这些是艺术家在较早访谈中的陈述。[Interview Magazine](https://www.interviewmagazine.com/art/for-artist-diedrick-brackens-weaving-is-an-act-of-religion)；[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/culture/2025/jan/16/textile-artist-diedrick-brackens-tapestry-woven-stories)。

这些线索在他此前的展览中各有不同重心。2025 年英国巴斯的一场旧展，评论者 Anna Souter 把棉花、跨大西洋劳动史和多种编织传统放在一起讨论；在波士顿美术馆的委托项目中，馆方则以鲶鱼引出艺术家的南方故乡和祖先，同时把作品置于新英格兰纺织历史的脉络中。更早对奥斯汀展览的报道也留意到德州经验中同时存在庇护与伤害。这些例子让材料和动物意象拥有具体的地理与历史，而不是一套固定密码。[Hyperallergic 巴斯展评](https://hyperallergic.com/diedrick-brackens-unravels-and-re-weaves-histories/)；[波士顿美术馆](https://www.mfa.org/exhibition/the-banner-project-diedrick-brackens)；[Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/textile-artist-diedrick-brackens-recasts-symbols-of-life-and-death-in-texas/)。

“世界尽头的光”是一个开放的标题。它既可能让人想到危机，也为继续生活留下空间。回看 Brackens 的其他展览与他对观众的讲述，会发现这些作品并不要求观者先掌握一套密码；色彩、织物和图像本身也提供了靠近的入口。[Hyperallergic 的既往展评](https://hyperallergic.com/diedrick-brackenss-tapestries-beckon-the-light-of-freedom/)；[Hammer Museum 采访](https://hammer.ucla.edu/blog/2018/09/interview-with-family-day-artist-diedrick-brackens)。
stories.enMarkdown:
“Diedrick Brackens: lights at the end of the world” opened at the Baltimore Museum of Art on November 8 and runs through February 28, 2027. The museum connects the new works to histories of the Chesapeake region, with imagery including light and horses. The exhibition places textiles within a conversation about place, memory and the future. [BMA exhibition page](https://artbma.org/exhibition/diedrick-brackens-lights-at-the-end-of-the-world/); [museum press material](https://artbma.org/press-release/bma-presents-new-work-by-acclaimed-artist-diedrick-brackens/).

Brackens’s choice of weaving is about more than a soft surface. In a studio conversation with Art21 he discussed cotton’s relationship to histories of labor: materials carry histories, and making takes time. That background helps explain how ordinary matter can hold complex narratives, without reducing every new work to a single fixed meaning. [Art21 studio conversation](https://art21.org/read/in-the-studio-diedrick-brackens/).

He has previously discussed weaving in relation to the body, belief and images; a 2025 Guardian interview recorded his approach to storytelling in textile. These statements come from earlier interviews. [Interview Magazine](https://www.interviewmagazine.com/art/for-artist-diedrick-brackens-weaving-is-an-act-of-religion); [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/culture/2025/jan/16/textile-artist-diedrick-brackens-tapestry-woven-stories).

Earlier exhibitions have brought different parts of that history into focus. Reviewing a 2025 show in Bath, England, Anna Souter discussed cotton alongside transatlantic labor histories and several weaving traditions. For a commission at the Museum of Fine Arts Boston, the museum connected Brackens’s catfish imagery to his Southern roots and ancestry, while placing the commission in the context of New England’s textile history. A still earlier account of his Austin exhibition considered Texas as a place of both refuge and harm. These examples give materials and animal imagery specific geographies and histories rather than a fixed code. [Hyperallergic on the Bath show](https://hyperallergic.com/diedrick-brackens-unravels-and-re-weaves-histories/); [Museum of Fine Arts Boston](https://www.mfa.org/exhibition/the-banner-project-diedrick-brackens); [Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/textile-artist-diedrick-brackens-recasts-symbols-of-life-and-death-in-texas/).

“Lights at the end of the world” is an open title, capable of suggesting both crisis and room to continue living. Looking at Brackens’s earlier exhibitions and his own conversations with audiences suggests that a viewer need not begin with a codebook: color, textile and image offer ways in. [Hyperallergic on a previous show](https://hyperallergic.com/diedrick-brackenss-tapestries-beckon-the-light-of-freedom/); [Hammer Museum interview](https://hammer.ucla.edu/blog/2018/09/interview-with-family-day-artist-diedrick-brackens).

stories.title: Carole Feuerman 的泳者雕塑来到洛杉矶街头
stories.titleEn: Carole Feuerman’s swimmers take to Beverly Hills
stories.zhDeck: 比佛利山庄罗迪欧大道迎来 Carole A. Feuerman 的公共雕塑展《Monuments of Stillness》。
stories.enDeck: Carole A. Feuerman’s public sculpture exhibition “Monuments of Stillness” has arrived on Rodeo Drive in Beverly Hills.
stories.zhMarkdown:
比佛利山庄罗迪欧大道迎来 Carole A. Feuerman 的公共雕塑展《Monuments of Stillness》。市政府介绍，展览于 2026 年 11 月 9 日开始，持续至 2027 年，十件雕塑散布于公共空间。城市将它描述为艺术家在美国西海岸的重要公共展览；具体位置与开放安排应以市政府页面为准。[比佛利山庄市政府](https://www.beverlyhills.org/1839/Carole-Feurerman-Monuments-of-Stillness)；[Beverly Press 展前报道](https://beverlypress.com/2026/10/feuermans-monuments-transform-rodeo-drive/)。

Feuerman 长期以高度写实的人体雕塑为人所知，尤其是泳者。她在《Sculpture》采访中回忆，早期泳者作品的线索来自海边看到的女孩。这个起点很私人，后来却发展成一系列关于身体、休息、力量和专注的公共图像。[Sculpture Magazine 采访](https://sculpturemagazine.art/getting-hyper-real-a-conversation-with-carole-a-feuerman/)。

写实并不是仅靠“像”完成的。艺术家在访谈里谈过模型、材料与制作过程，提醒我们：皮肤、水滴和姿态等熟悉细节，都要经过漫长的选择与制作。看似自然的一瞬间，其实是被固定、放大并移到街道上的结果。[Curator 的历史访谈](https://curator.site/interviews/2017/2/5/carole-feuerman)；[Impulse Magazine 对话](https://www.impulsemagazine.com/articles/50-years-of-american-sculpture-in-conversation-with-carole-feuerman)。

她对户外观看的兴趣也延续了多年。2023 年纽约 Park Avenue 曾展示九件 Feuerman 雕塑；当地电视台当时记录，她希望路人与作品产生联系。比利时列日 La Boverie 的一份旧展指南则把《General’s Twin》和《Catalina》中的水滴与平静姿态，读作身体和自我之间的平衡。一个发生在街道上，一个来自展厅解说，都帮助理解她如何把极细的表面处理转化为关于人的感受。[ABC7 纽约旧展报道](https://abc7ny.com/post/art-sculpture-park-avenue-carole-feuerman/13209039/)；[La Boverie 展览指南](https://www.liege.be/en/discover/culture/museums/la-boverie/exhibitions/past-exhibitions/visitor-guide-en-dd-20200513.pdf/view)。

在罗迪欧大道，这些作品与橱窗、行人和商业街的速度相邻。展览标题里的“静止”因此不仅是人物姿态，也可以是观看方式：路过的人可以短暂停下，重新注意公共空间里的身体。Feuerman 此前在巴黎展示跳水者作品的经历，说明她持续在不同城市测试人体雕塑与公共环境的关系。[路透社 2024 年报道](https://www.reuters.com/sports/olympics/american-artist-feuerman-aims-inspire-with-her-diver-sculpture-2024-07-29/)。
stories.enMarkdown:
Carole A. Feuerman’s public sculpture exhibition “Monuments of Stillness” has arrived on Rodeo Drive in Beverly Hills. The city says it began on November 9, 2026 and continues into 2027, with ten sculptures in public space. It describes the project as a major West Coast public presentation for the artist; visitors should check the city’s page for locations and current arrangements. [City of Beverly Hills](https://www.beverlyhills.org/1839/Carole-Feurerman-Monuments-of-Stillness); [Beverly Press preview](https://beverlypress.com/2026/10/feuermans-monuments-transform-rodeo-drive/).

Feuerman is known for highly realistic figures, particularly swimmers. In an interview with *Sculpture*, she recalled that an early swimmer was connected to a girl she saw at the seaside. A private observation became the starting point for a recurring public vocabulary of bodies, rest, strength and concentration. [Sculpture Magazine interview](https://sculpturemagazine.art/getting-hyper-real-a-conversation-with-carole-a-feuerman/).

Realism requires more than resemblance. In interviews the artist has discussed models, materials and process, a reminder that familiar details such as skin, water droplets and posture result from sustained choices and labor. What looks like a natural instant has been fixed, enlarged and moved into the street. [Curator interview](https://curator.site/interviews/2017/2/5/carole-feuerman); [Impulse Magazine conversation](https://www.impulsemagazine.com/articles/50-years-of-american-sculpture-in-conversation-with-carole-feuerman).

Her interest in encountering sculpture outdoors has developed over years. Nine Feuerman sculptures appeared on Park Avenue in New York in 2023, and local television recorded her hope that passersby would connect with the work. A guide to an earlier exhibition at La Boverie in Liège read the droplets and composed poses of *General’s Twin* and *Catalina* in relation to a sense of balance with one’s body. One account comes from the street and the other from a museum guide; together they help explain how detailed surfaces can carry an emotional idea. [ABC7 on the New York show](https://abc7ny.com/post/art-sculpture-park-avenue-carole-feuerman/13209039/); [La Boverie exhibition guide](https://www.liege.be/en/discover/culture/museums/la-boverie/exhibitions/past-exhibitions/visitor-guide-en-dd-20200513.pdf/view).

On Rodeo Drive, the works sit alongside shop windows, pedestrians and the pace of a commercial street. “Stillness” can describe a way of looking as well as a pose: a passerby may pause and notice a body in public space anew. A previous presentation of a diver in Paris shows Feuerman’s continuing interest in sculpture’s relationship to different cities. [Reuters, 2024](https://www.reuters.com/sports/olympics/american-artist-feuerman-aims-inspire-with-her-diver-sculpture-2024-07-29/).

stories.title: Danielle Mckinney：女性在室内的安静时刻
stories.titleEn: Danielle Mckinney’s “Shelter” makes room for solitude
stories.zhDeck: Danielle Mckinney 的《Shelter》于 11 月 6 日在新奥尔良艺术博物馆（NOMA）开启，展至 2027 年 8 月 15 日。
stories.enDeck: Danielle Mckinney’s “Shelter” opened November 6 at the New Orleans Museum of Art and runs through August 15, 2027.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Danielle Mckinney 的《Shelter》于 11 月 6 日在新奥尔良艺术博物馆（NOMA）开启，展至 2027 年 8 月 15 日。展览此前在 Norton Museum of Art 呈现。它围绕艺术家描绘女性室内生活的绘画展开：休息、独处和看似没有发生什么的时间成为值得仔细观看的主题。[NOMA 展览信息](https://noma.org/exhibitions/danielle-mckinney-shelter/)；[NOMA 开幕新闻稿](https://www.neworleans.com/articles/post/noma-to-open-solo-exhibition-of-works-by-contemporary-painter-danielle-mckinney/)；[WLRN 关于 Norton 展览的报道](https://www.wlrn.org/light/arts-culture/2026-03-25/norton-museum-art-by-women-recognition-series)。

Mckinney 的人物常处于幽暗的室内，绘画把注意力引向身体、家具和光线之间的关系。她在采访中澄清，这些人物并不应简单视为她的自画像。画面中的私人空间是真实感受的容器，却不自动等同于艺术家的私人生活记录。[Wallpaper* 采访](https://www.wallpaper.com/art/danielle-mckinney-interview)；[BOMB 对话](https://bombmagazine.org/articles/2026/08/26/danielle-mckinney-by-salom%C3%A9-g%C3%B3mez-upegui/)。

这种绘画的力量也许来自对“事件”的重新排序：一个人坐着、抽烟或休息，并不需要被解释成某个更大情节的前奏。关于她较早作品的评论，讨论过黑人女性休息的可见性以及室内场景中的自持；两篇评论分别讨论了她在其他展览中的作品。[Hyperallergic 既往评论](https://hyperallergic.com/danielle-mckinneys-portraits-of-black-women-at-rest/)；[另一篇展评](https://hyperallergic.com/the-feminine-abandon-of-danielle-mckinney/)。

她的黑色底层还有一层来自摄影的经验。Mckinney 在 2024 年接受《卫报》采访时说，她试过白色和棕色底色，最终发现黑色更接近暗房：人物仿佛从中慢慢显现。另一次都灵旧展采访里，她谈到转向绘画后，自己能够以不同于摄影的方式控制人物如何被呈现。[The Guardian 采访](https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/2024/apr/17/danielle-mckinney-portraits-black-women-quiet-storm)；[AnOther 采访](https://www.anothermag.com/art-photography/15531/danielle-mckinney-interview-fly-on-the-wall-exhibition)。

如何观看这些室内，也可以从艺术史重新进入。Rose Art Museum 旧展策展人 Gannit Ankori 曾把 Mckinney 的人物姿态与欧洲绘画中的卧姿传统并置，认为她的人物保有自己的节奏；这是策展人对旧展的解读。更早的 Vogue 采访中，艺术家则把独处与暂时放下外部形象联系起来。两种声音共同让“休息”不再只是静物般的姿势，而成为谁拥有空间、谁能决定如何被看的问题。[Misstropolis 策展人对话](https://www.misstropolis.com/home/danielle-mckinney)；[Vogue 人物采访](https://www.vogue.com/article/danielle-mckinney-artist-profile-october-2022)。

《Shelter》这个标题让避难所既像一间房，也像一种短暂获得的自主权：人物可以不为旁观者表演。艺术家在有关该展的访谈中谈到绘画和空间，展览因此提供了一个机会，去看她怎样用暗色和留白让安静成为画面的中心。[Cultured 采访](https://culturedmag.com/article/2026/05/07/art-danielle-mckinney-painter-interview-shelter/)；[Whitewall 人物报道](https://whitewall.art/art/danielle-mckinney-paints-the-sacred-space-of-interior-life/)。
stories.enMarkdown:
Danielle Mckinney’s “Shelter” opened November 6 at the New Orleans Museum of Art and runs through August 15, 2027. Previously presented at the Norton Museum of Art, it centers on the artist’s paintings of women’s interior lives, making rest, solitude and apparently uneventful time worthy of close attention. [NOMA exhibition information](https://noma.org/exhibitions/danielle-mckinney-shelter/); [NOMA opening press release](https://www.neworleans.com/articles/post/noma-to-open-solo-exhibition-of-works-by-contemporary-painter-danielle-mckinney/); [WLRN on the Norton presentation](https://www.wlrn.org/light/arts-culture/2026-03-25/norton-museum-art-by-women-recognition-series).

Mckinney’s figures often occupy dark interiors; her paintings direct attention to relationships among bodies, furniture and light. She has clarified in interviews that the figures should not simply be read as self-portraits. A private room can hold a convincing feeling without becoming a literal record of the artist’s private life. [Wallpaper* interview](https://www.wallpaper.com/art/danielle-mckinney-interview); [BOMB conversation](https://bombmagazine.org/articles/2026/08/26/danielle-mckinney-by-salom%C3%A9-g%C3%B3mez-upegui/).

The work’s force may lie in reordering what counts as an event: a person sitting, smoking or resting need not be a prelude to a larger plot. Reviews of her earlier paintings have considered the visibility of Black women at rest and the composure of interior scenes. Those reviews provide context, not confirmation that their specific works are on view in New Orleans. [Earlier Hyperallergic review](https://hyperallergic.com/danielle-mckinneys-portraits-of-black-women-at-rest/); [another exhibition review](https://hyperallergic.com/the-feminine-abandon-of-danielle-mckinney/).

Her dark grounds also connect to her experience of photography. In a 2024 Guardian interview, Mckinney said she had tried white and brown grounds before finding that black felt more like a darkroom: figures seemed to emerge from it gradually. In a separate interview around an earlier Turin exhibition, she described how painting gave her a different kind of control over the representation of a figure. [The Guardian interview](https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/2024/apr/17/danielle-mckinney-portraits-black-women-quiet-storm); [AnOther interview](https://www.anothermag.com/art-photography/15531/danielle-mckinney-interview-fly-on-the-wall-exhibition).

Art history offers another way into these rooms. Gannit Ankori, curator of an earlier exhibition at the Rose Art Museum, set Mckinney’s figures alongside the reclining pose in European painting and argued that they possess a pace of their own; this is her reading of the earlier show. In a still earlier Vogue interview, the artist connected solitude with a temporary release from an outward persona. Together, those perspectives make rest a question of who possesses a space and who decides how a figure is seen. [Misstropolis curator conversation](https://www.misstropolis.com/home/danielle-mckinney); [Vogue profile](https://www.vogue.com/article/danielle-mckinney-artist-profile-october-2022).

The title “Shelter” suggests both a room and a temporary form of autonomy: a figure need not perform for an observer. In interviews about the exhibition, Mckinney has discussed painting and space. The show offers a chance to consider how darkness and open space can make quiet the center of an image. [Cultured interview](https://culturedmag.com/article/2026/05/07/art-danielle-mckinney-painter-interview-shelter/); [Whitewall profile](https://whitewall.art/art/danielle-mckinney-paints-the-sacred-space-of-interior-life/).
