stories.title: PSI-01：把贝鲁特的供电状况做成一个物件
stories.titleEn: Dia Mrad makes an unstable power system visible
stories.zhDeck: 黎巴嫩设计师 Dia Mrad 的《PSI-01》获得 2026 年 Design Doha Prize 的产品设计奖。
stories.enDeck: Lebanese designer Dia Mrad’s PSI-01 received the product design award at the 2026 Design Doha Prize.
stories.zhMarkdown:
黎巴嫩设计师 Dia Mrad 的《PSI-01》获得 2026 年 Design Doha Prize 的产品设计奖。关于该奖项的报道将它描述为一件以家庭供电系统为背景的作品：电力的来源和切换，原本藏在日常生活背后，被转译为可以被看见的形式。[卡塔尔通讯社获奖报道](https://qna.org.qa/en/news/news-details?date=8%2F11%2F2026&id=chairperson-of-qatar-museums-honors-winners-of-doha-design-prize-2026)；[YUNG 获奖报道](https://thisisyungmea.com/dia-mrad-wins-at-design-doha-prize-2026/)。

《PSI-01》与黎巴嫩长期面临的电力不稳定有关。它使用钢结构并与家庭电力信息相连，使不同供电状态成为一种公共可感知的信号。作品呈现供电情况，实际供电问题仍需要基础设施方案。[Architectural Digest Middle East 获奖报道](https://www.admiddleeast.com/story/design-doha-prize-2026-winners)；[L’Orient-Le Jour 对设计师的报道](https://www.lorientlejour.com/article/1547076/pour-dia-mrad-la-photo-mene-a-tout-au-design-dimpact-surtout.html)。

Mrad 的实践横跨摄影、设计和对城市系统的观察。他在采访中谈到如何把生存策略和基础设施作为创作线索；较早的项目也记录了日常生活与供电条件之间的关系。把这些经历放在一起看，《PSI-01》不是突然出现的科技造型，而是对一个长期问题的另一种表达。[Khamsa 采访](https://khamsa.com/culture/creative-talks-dia-mrad-on-signals-systems-survival/)；[ICON 对其创作的报道](https://icon.ink/articles/power-adapters-and-the-power-of-adapting/)。

Mrad 对供电系统的关注早于这次获奖。2023 年沙迦建筑三年展的《Power Shifts》用贝鲁特屋顶太阳能板的航拍图像，观察城市如何为电力不足寻找分散的应对方式；这个项目又承接了他记录水箱、提款机与太阳能板的《Utilities》。旧展图录将《PSI-01》列为约 2.4 米高的焊接钢结构，以开关和背光面板指示不同电源状态。它把原本分散在屋顶和家庭里的系统压缩成一个可以阅读的对象。[沙迦建筑三年展](https://2023.sharjaharchitecture.org/projects/power-shifts)；[旧展图录](https://a.storyblok.com/f/248929/x/279a9cf4b6/totems-of-the-present-the-absent.pdf)。

这种设计也有明确的生活背景。美联社 2026 年的报道提到，黎巴嫩国有电力供应有限，许多居民依靠私人柴油发电机补足；各家庭获得电力的条件并不相同。《PSI-01》能做的是让这种切换显形，从而把原本需要家庭反复适应的问题带入公共讨论。[Associated Press](https://apnews.com/article/66cab202c080e0a5fba683dcbe32775d)。

它最有意思的地方在于，设计没有把故障藏起来，反而让一套通常只有居民自己能感受到的系统进入公共视野。让状态可见，为讨论提供了具体的起点。作品获得设计奖，也让地区性的生活经验进入更广泛的设计讨论。[AD Middle East 关于黎巴嫩创作者的对话](https://www.admiddleeast.com/story/the-creative-condition-five-lebanese-creatives-on-what-it-means-to-keep-going)。
stories.enMarkdown:
Lebanese designer Dia Mrad’s *PSI-01* received the product design award at the 2026 Design Doha Prize. Coverage describes a work rooted in household electricity: the sources and switching that usually remain behind everyday life are translated into a visible form. [Qatar News Agency’s winners report](https://qna.org.qa/en/news/news-details?date=8%2F11%2F2026&id=chairperson-of-qatar-museums-honors-winners-of-doha-design-prize-2026); [YUNG report](https://thisisyungmea.com/dia-mrad-wins-at-design-doha-prize-2026/).

The work relates to Lebanon’s prolonged electricity instability. A steel structure connected to information about household power makes changing supply conditions perceptible. There is an essential distinction: the work communicates supply conditions; it does not itself generate more electricity or repair a grid. [Architectural Digest Middle East on the prize](https://www.admiddleeast.com/story/design-doha-prize-2026-winners); [L’Orient-Le Jour profile](https://www.lorientlejour.com/article/1547076/pour-dia-mrad-la-photo-mene-a-tout-au-design-dimpact-surtout.html).

Mrad’s practice moves among photography, design and observation of urban systems. He has discussed survival strategies and infrastructure as creative material, and earlier projects have documented the relationship between everyday life and power supply. In that context, *PSI-01* is another expression of a longstanding inquiry rather than an isolated technological shape. [Khamsa interview](https://khamsa.com/culture/creative-talks-dia-mrad-on-signals-systems-survival/); [ICON profile](https://icon.ink/articles/power-adapters-and-the-power-of-adapting/).

Mrad’s attention to power systems predates the prize. His *Power Shifts* at the 2023 Sharjah Architecture Triennial used aerial images of rooftop solar panels in Beirut to consider how residents adapt to inadequate electricity. It developed from *Utilities*, a project documenting water tanks, cash machines and solar panels. A previous exhibition catalogue describes *PSI-01* as a roughly 2.4-metre welded-steel structure using switches and backlit panels to indicate different power states. It condenses systems distributed across roofs and homes into an object that can be read. [Sharjah Architecture Triennial](https://2023.sharjaharchitecture.org/projects/power-shifts); [earlier exhibition catalogue](https://a.storyblok.com/f/248929/x/279a9cf4b6/totems-of-the-present-the-absent.pdf).

The design has a concrete everyday context. An Associated Press report in 2026 described limited public electricity supply in Lebanon and residents’ reliance on private diesel generators; access differs between households. *PSI-01* makes switching visible, bringing a problem that households repeatedly have to accommodate into public discussion. [Associated Press](https://apnews.com/article/66cab202c080e0a5fba683dcbe32775d).

The project’s interest lies in making a system that residents usually experience privately visible in public. Seeing its condition does not solve the underlying problem, but it gives discussion a more concrete starting point. The design prize also brings a situated experience into a wider conversation. [AD Middle East on Lebanese creative practice](https://www.admiddleeast.com/story/the-creative-condition-five-lebanese-creatives-on-what-it-means-to-keep-going).

stories.title: 多哈驻留创作者如何回应沙漠、海岸与迁移
stories.titleEn: Doha’s first AISP exhibition brings a learning process into public view
stories.zhDeck: 多哈 Fire Station 的艺术家密集学习计划（AISP）迎来首届成果展，展期为 2026 年 11 月 8 日至 2027 年 2 月 6 日。
stories.enDeck: The first exhibition of the Artists’ Intensive Study Program (AISP) at Doha’s Fire Station runs from November 8, 2026 through February 6, 2027.
stories.zhMarkdown:
多哈 Fire Station 的艺术家密集学习计划（AISP）迎来首届成果展，展期为 2026 年 11 月 8 日至 2027 年 2 月 6 日。卡塔尔博物馆的展览信息列出 22 位来自 15 个国家的艺术家，作品分布于五个空间。它呈现的是学习项目之后的一次公共展览，而不只是工作室里的阶段汇报。[卡塔尔博物馆展览页](https://qm.org.qa/en/calendar/aisp-first-edition-exhibition/)；[Fire Station 项目介绍](https://firestation.org.qa/en/calendar/aisp/)。

这个计划于 2025 年秋开始，经过约九个月的学习和交流。项目早期介绍的入选人数，与最后的参展人数分别对应不同阶段。Fire Station 由消防站转型为艺术机构的历史，也让项目与建筑本身的再利用形成联系。[Fire Station 项目页](https://firestation.org.qa/en/calendar/aisp/)；[场馆历史报道](https://www.katar.cz/en/fire-station-transformed-its-artist-residencies-into-an-intensive-study-programme)。

参与者有不同的工作方法。艺术家 Alla Abdunabi 的既往介绍谈到她对当地材料、动物标本与研究的兴趣；Fire Station 对 Hissa Al Kuwari 的介绍则提供另一条理解艺术家实践的路径。这些资料呈现出参与者不同的创作方向。[Alla Abdunabi 既往资料](https://www.gagallery.com/press/power-of-culture)；[Hissa Al Kuwari 艺术家介绍](https://firestation.org.qa/en/artists/hissa-alkuwari/)。

首届展也能从某一位创作者的工作方式切入。Aiza Ahmed 在接受 Artsy 采访时谈到，她在多哈注意到海边的人、船夫与司机；她常先看着对象而不低头看纸面画轮廓，再把这些观察发展为绘画、纺织或木雕。艺术家对当地男性气质的感受来自她自己的生活经验，也让这次驻留的“地方”有了具体的人和关系。[Artsy 人物报道](https://www.artsy.net/article/artsy-editorial-artsy-vanguard-2027-aiza-ahmed)。

在最终展出之前，工作室已经被设计成交流的场所。Fire Station 曾预告 2026 年 2 月的开放工作室，9 月的参访活动介绍也安排观众以小组进入工作空间，接触草图并与艺术家交流。工作室里的试验和尚未完成的想法，由此成为理解最终作品的一条路径。[卡塔尔通讯社活动预告](https://qna.org.qa/en/news/news-details?date=1%2F02%2F2026&id=behind-the-canvas-fire-station-invites-public-into-artists-studios)；[Qatar Creates 参访信息](https://ticketing.qacreates.com/event/inside-the-studio-an-encounter-with-artists-in-r-62jj86)。

与项目相关的 Al Markhiya Gallery 也有独立展示，展期和艺术家范围与 Fire Station 主展各自独立。AISP 的价值正在于这种从学习、工作室到不同公共空间的转译：同一批艺术家的探索可以在不同场景中被重新认识，但每个场地仍应保有自己的信息和署名。[Al Markhiya Gallery 展览页](https://almarkhiyagallery.com/artists-intensive-study-program-first-edition-exhibition/)；[Qatar Museums 主展信息](https://qm.org.qa/en/calendar/aisp-first-edition-exhibition/)。
stories.enMarkdown:
The first exhibition of the Artists’ Intensive Study Program (AISP) at Doha’s Fire Station runs from November 8, 2026 through February 6, 2027. Qatar Museums lists 22 artists from 15 countries across five spaces. The result is a public exhibition following a period of learning, rather than only an internal studio progress report. [Qatar Museums exhibition page](https://qm.org.qa/en/calendar/aisp-first-edition-exhibition/); [Fire Station program page](https://firestation.org.qa/en/calendar/aisp/).

The program began in autumn 2025 and involved approximately nine months of study and exchange. Early descriptions of the cohort and the eventual number of exhibiting artists can differ: one refers to the program, the other to this exhibition, and they should not be collapsed into a single unverified figure. Fire Station’s own history as a converted fire station adds another dimension of reuse to the project. [Fire Station program](https://firestation.org.qa/en/calendar/aisp/); [history of the venue](https://www.katar.cz/en/fire-station-transformed-its-artist-residencies-into-an-intensive-study-programme).

Participants bring different methods. Earlier material about Alla Abdunabi discusses local research, animal specimens and materials; Fire Station’s profile of Hissa Al Kuwari offers another route into an artist’s practice. The profiles show the different directions of their practices. [Earlier Alla Abdunabi profile](https://www.gagallery.com/press/power-of-culture); [Hissa Al Kuwari artist page](https://firestation.org.qa/en/artists/hissa-alkuwari/).

One participant’s working method offers a more particular way into the exhibition. In an Artsy interview, Aiza Ahmed described noticing people by the water, boatmen and drivers in Doha. She often begins by drawing a contour while watching her subject rather than the paper, then develops those observations into paintings, textiles or carved wood. Her impressions of masculinity in the city come from her own experience and give the residency’s sense of place a human scale. [Artsy profile](https://www.artsy.net/article/artsy-editorial-artsy-vanguard-2027-aiza-ahmed).

Before the final exhibition, the studio was already conceived as a place for exchange. Fire Station announced an open-studio event for February 2026; a September visit was also planned for small groups to enter workspaces, encounter sketches and speak with artists. Experiments and unfinished ideas can offer a route into the eventual work. [Qatar News Agency preview](https://qna.org.qa/en/news/news-details?date=1%2F02%2F2026&id=behind-the-canvas-fire-station-invites-public-into-artists-studios); [Qatar Creates visit information](https://ticketing.qacreates.com/event/inside-the-studio-an-encounter-with-artists-in-r-62jj86).

Al Markhiya Gallery also presents a related, separate exhibition, with its own dates and artist selection. AISP’s interest lies partly in the translation from learning and studios into different public settings, while each venue retains its own information and credits. [Al Markhiya Gallery exhibition](https://almarkhiyagallery.com/artists-intensive-study-program-first-edition-exhibition/); [Qatar Museums main exhibition](https://qm.org.qa/en/calendar/aisp-first-edition-exhibition/).
